notes.title: 08/29 Hotfix
notes.content:
[p]Hello,[/p][p]This is the IfSunSets development team.[/p][p]We’d like to inform you that a hotfix has been updated.[/p][p]We will continue to provide regular hotfix support whenever issues arise.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Update Version:: v0.6.5.8[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Important Notice[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]A frame drop issue has recently been identified on AMD graphics cards.[/p][h3][b]To address this, we have added an option at game startup to choose between DirectX 11 and DirectX 12.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/00d4e5f9621eead9c90be56f6e450bd4860cd446.png"][/img][/p][p]We recommend using DirectX 11 by default.[/p][p]However, if you experience severe frame drops during gameplay, we suggest trying DirectX 12.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Hotfix Details[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]🛠️ \[BugFix][/b][/h3][h3][b]An overload issue occurs when checking too many building modules in "Material Recovery" mode.[/b][/h3][p]When selecting a building module (part) for destruction, the connected modules (parts) are highlighted.[/p][p]We have fixed an issue where having too many connected modules could cause overload, leading to critical errors or severe frame drops.[/p][p][/p][p]Please keep this in mind while playing the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]We are continuously working on fixing crashes and errors in the game[/b]

If you experience any issues after the patch, please tell us in our discord.

notes.title: 08/27 Small Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello,[/p][p]This is the IfSunSets development team.[/p][p]We’re pleased to inform you that the game has been updated.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Update Version: v0.6.5[/b][/h3][p][/p][h2][b]■ Main Update Details[/b][/h2][p][b]The camera angle during NPC conversations has been adjusted.[/b][/p][p]Enjoy a more immersive dialogue experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/5aa2e3526f06b17dcb4b3bdcb38f01c07ec43f67.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The attack animations of Crocodiles and One-Eyed Crocs have been updated.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f4171e54c055af318cc4f7a75432fe1abdd0f1a5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]A new concept of “Minor Knockback” has been added, allowing you to recover quickly and prepare for the next attack even when knocked back.[/b][/p][p]Minor Knockback attacks can be blocked with a weapon guard.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/28bd3858bc04f2ade8885bb4778707f80c6535f5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]35 Steam achievements have been updated.[/b][/p][p]However, the two achievements [b]"It's me! Ma..r…"[/b] and [b]"You know there's an easy mode, right?"[/b] have only gone through internal testing and have not been fully verified.[/p][p]If an achievement does not unlock, please leave an inquiry.[/p][p]We will check it promptly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ae58004dfc083c49d592f56f8aa72baf7a642a71.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Construction Mallet and Trap Mallet have been unified, and the UI has been redesigned.[/b][/p][p]The Trap Mallet has been merged into the regular Mallet and will no longer appear in the game.[/p][p]Based on feedback that the previous system was inconvenient, both the UI and workflow have been improved.[/p][p]Functions such as selecting Construction Mode and switching module types have been updated.[/p][p]It may take some time to get used to, but once you do, the new system will provide a much more convenient building experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/67ff69bff04eaae77486a47d3a7e043eea5ce378.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Update Details[/b][/h2][h3][b]🛠️ \[bugFix][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where trap springs did not function properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where unobtainable items remained in the compendium.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with duplicate recipes for certain dishes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a terrain gap near the mountains by the swamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing [b]C[/b] while entering a bed name triggered the crouch action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing compendium entry, recipe, and item for Mushroom Tea.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing recipe item for Flower Tea.[/p][/*][*][p]The gliding acceleration key guide now appears only when gliding is active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the “Show/Hide Equipment” menu appeared when right-clicking on unequipped items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dismantling the Cthugha Resonator yielded an abnormal amount of resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an incorrect UI appeared after placing a lantern on a display stand and clicking “Turn On Lantern.”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed gaps in certain parts of the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Nameless Captain did not respawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an invisible collision box existed above the Energy Farm.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where trap durability was displayed incorrectly when the “Master of Traps” trait was applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some monsters were not registered in the Monster Compendium.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Purified equipment below [b]Fine[/b] grade was missing the Contamination Resistance option.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Fine Desert Armor: Helmet[/b] did not apply additional options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where options on the [b]Fine Crocodile Helmet[/b] were applied abnormally.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🌐 \[Multiplayer][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where monster movement animations between attacks appeared unnatural from the guest’s perspective.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]We are continuously working on fixing crashes and errors in the game[/b]

If you experience any issues after the patch, please tell us in our discord.
Your feedback is always welcome. You can write your feedback on Steam or Discord.

Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/Ifsunsets"]https://discord.gg/Ifsunsets[/url]

notes.title: 08/13 Small Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hello,[/p][p]This is the [i]IfSunSets[/i] development team.[/p][p]The game has been Updated.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Update Version: v0.6.4[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Major Update Details[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Status Effect:[/b] Poison status has been added, along with a visual effect to indicate the poison status.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status Effect:[/b] A visual effect to indicate the Bleed status has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phantom Limb Transformation[/b] can now be performed while moving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aerial Phantom Limb:[/b] Wire can now be used in midair.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aerial Phantom Limb:[/b] Wire skills can now be used in midair.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phantom Limb:[/b] Wire now consumes Limb only when it hits the target.[/p][/*][*][p]The quest display on the HUD has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]A boost system has been added to the glider.[/p][/*][*][p]The visual effect shown when a monster becomes incapacitated has been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]A lantern ON/OFF function has been added. (You can toggle it by pressing the button in the inventory slot. A hotkey option will be added in the future.)[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips now show an icon indicating books or blueprints you have already read.[/p][/*][*][p]When chopping down a tree, items will now be automatically added to your inventory with each hit (similar to mining ores), and once all items have been collected, the tree will fall.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]■ Update Details[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🔧 \[Changes & Additions][/b][/h3][list][*][p]The battle area for the Golden Wing Tribe Chief has been redesigned into a larger space for more comfortable combat.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Golden Wing Tribe Chief[/b]’s motion has been completely overhauled.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phantom Limb:[/b] Wire now consumes Limb only when it hits the target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phantom Limb:[/b] Fixed unnatural movement when using a shield while moving.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🛠️ \[Bug Fix][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the character selection UI overlapped in 16:10 resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing ESC while the guide was displayed did not work.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Fracture debuff could be ignored by opening and closing any popup while it was active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Farmer skill did not apply to newly placed fields.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where feed could not be properly placed into the chicken coop and feed trough.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the pouch generated when butchering animals would occasionally bounce away.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the weapon skill cooldown UI did not update when no weapon was equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Dull Iron Sword used one-handed sword animations instead of two-handed sword animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where night monsters could not properly climb slopes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a specific rock peak in Snakehead Mountain had no collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the gravestone spawned in an abnormal location when dying during a boss battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with abnormal collision on the Bombale.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain objects inside the Shark Tooth Pirate Base had unnatural collisions and textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the growth speed of some pine trees was inconsistent.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where feed inside the feed trough appeared transparent.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where being attacked by Sand Flea: Sticky while Fairy’s Protection was active would cause the Fracture status to last indefinitely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the difficulty preset in World Settings was displayed in Korean in other languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some trees could not be hit with the weapon skill of the Nameless Captain’s Sword.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain document items did not exist in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where attacking seated monsters with certain fairy skills caused them to move while remaining seated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the equipment comparison tooltip prevented viewing decoration details.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the bed popup UI did not respond to the first click.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ESC key could not be used while the bed UI was displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed so that Sprint cannot be used while guarding with Phantom Limb.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Perfect Guard would restore health equal to the damage received.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the chest loot quantity option did not apply correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the “Rage” skill text was displayed differently in the skill tree and traits window.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🌐 \[Multiplayer][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the world was visible before the loading screen when a guest entered the world.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the fairy animation would stop when a guest clicked on the fairy’s appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where daily quests in the guest environment did not refresh even after a day had passed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the guest’s camera shake option followed the host’s settings.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]

[b]We are continuously working on fixing crashes and errors in the game[/b]

If you experience any issues after the patch, please tell us in our discord.
Your feedback is always welcome. You can write your feedback on Steam or Discord.

notes.title: 07/28 Hotfix
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hello,[/p][p]This is the IfSunSets development team.[/p][p]A hotfix has been released and we’d like to inform you of the update.[/p][p]We will continue to provide prompt hotfix support whenever issues arise.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Update Version: v0.6.3[/b][/h3][p][/p][h2][/h2][h2][b]■ Major Hotfix Details[/b][/h2][p]The issue where wave monsters would spawn inside castles and dungeons during Night of the Dead has been resolved.[/p][p]We identified and fixed the cause of the previously known issue where wave monsters were spawning inside dungeons and castles during Night of the Dead.[/p][p]The issue where tombstones would sometimes disappear, preventing players from retrieving their items, has also been fixed.[/p][p]We resolved the problem where tombstones would not appear at the death location, making it impossible to recover lost items.[/p][p]We fixed an issue where unlocking a cooking recipe would incorrectly unlock a different dish instead of the intended one.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Hotfix Details[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🔧 \[Changes & Additions][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added previews when selecting unlearned fairy skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several floating or embedded objects inside the Golden Wing Base.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visibility of the water scooping UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed terrain holes in the Jungle Mountains.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed terrain gaps in the Abandoned Village and Witch’s Forest.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fairy’s Protection skill can now block harmful effects such as bleeding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where landscape textures were loading too slowly.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where background shadows in certain areas would shift incorrectly when rotating the camera.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🛠️ \[Bug Fixes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where night monsters appeared in the daytime monster compendium.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the image for the Bronze Pickaxe and Iron Pickaxe, which were previously displayed as the same.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where monsters could be inflicted with permanent bleeding using a bleeding skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where attempting a backstab on "Golden Wing Tribe: Archer" would cause them to become invincible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a severe framerate drop when Wigglers were affected by burn status.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where animals became unrecoverable if a trough or chicken coop was retrieved along with nearby structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where trees could not be destroyed using weapon skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue where the damage of the Fairy Fang skill would decrease after loading or respawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the hit detection for rifles against "Sharktooth Pirates: Supply Trooper" to make them easier to hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI alignment issue when trying to open a container while a monster was dying.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the previous skill would activate if a fairy skill was used during a skill switch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Night of the Dead monsters could phase through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where some inventory items were not visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain recipes could not be unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected an issue where cooking pot recipe previews did not show the associated buff effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the abnormal respawn time for the Nameless Captain monster.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where shadows on the map were rendered incorrectly depending on the player's view.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem where Night of the Dead monsters were spawning inside dungeons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Night of the Dead monsters would enter bodies of water.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected an issue where "Bliphia bullet" could damage players regardless of PK settings.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][h3]🌐 [b]\[Multiplayer][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the background of the guest player's location appeared incorrectly on the host's screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the tombstone would sink into the ground or disappear after respawning.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]We are continuously working on fixing crashes and errors in the game[/b]

If you experience any issues after the patch, please tell us in our discord.

notes.title: 07/17 Hotfix
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hello,[/p][p]This is the IfSunSets development team.[/p][p]We’ve released a hotfix addressing the issues listed in our previous “Known Issues” notice.[/p][p]We will continue to provide prompt hotfixes as new issues arise.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Update Version: v0.6.2[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Important Notice[/b][/h2][p][u][b]The issue where wave monsters spawn inside castles and dungeons during the Night of the Dead will be resolved in the next hotfix.[/b][/u][/p][p]Among the issues listed in our Known Issues notice, we’ve identified the cause of wave monsters spawning inside dungeons and castles during the Night of the Dead.[/p][p]However, as we felt the need for additional testing, this fix was not included in the current hotfix.[/p][p]We’ll work to address it as soon as possible in an upcoming hotfix.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Major Hotfix Details[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Frame drop issues experienced by existing players have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Overall game performance has been further optimized.[/p][/*][*][p]Aiming issues with firearms have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]The bug that allowed unlimited Fairy Point farming notes.title: Problems that occurred after the 'Combat' update on July 14
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This is Polymorph Studio.[/p][p]Following the 0.6.0 'Combat' update, several issues have been reported.[/p][p]We are currently working on resolving these problems, and they will be addressed in an upcoming hotfix.[/p][p]We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Known Issues to Be Fixed in Upcoming Patch][/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b][u]Optimization Issues[/u][/b][/p][p]Some players have experienced frame drops after the update, especially when placing a large number of buildings.[/p][p]We have identified the cause of the issue and will be releasing a hotfix soon.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Issue where gun-type weapons do not aim accurately.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Issue where wave monsters spawn inside locations like the old castle and dungeons during Night of the Dead.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Bug that allows unlimited acquisition of Fairy Points.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Issue where using the Ctrl key for Phantom Limb also triggers other systems that use the same key.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Issue where the difficulty of Night of the Dead has increased compared to before.[/u][/b][/p][p]This issue was caused by a problem in the level scaling system.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Issue where previously built base camps were covered by the map due to terrain changes.[/u][/b][/p][p]This issue occurred while adjusting the layout of the world and will be restored to its original state soon.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b][u]Issue where weapon skill poise damage was too low.[/u][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]We will do our best to release a hotfix within this week.[/p][p]Once again, we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this has caused.[/p][p]Additionally, if you are experiencing any other serious bugs, please join our Discord server below and let us know —
we will prioritize fixing those issues.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]We are continuously working on fixing crashes and errors in the game[/b]

If you experience any issues after the patch, please tell us in our discord.

notes.title: ⚔️COMBAT OVERHAUL UPDATE⚔️
notes.content:
[h1][b]■ [/b]Updated version[b]: v0.6.0[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]This is the development team of [b]IfSunSets[/b]![/p][h3][b]⚔️ A brand-new Combat Update has arrived in IfSunSets! ⚔️[/b][/h3][p]In this update, we’ve introduced a new combat system along with various improvements and fixes.[/p][p]Check out the new content that truly lives up to the name of the [i]Combat[/i] update in [b]IfSunSets[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/5b5687c29ddbcdf1842995e193e0de6aa3cb044b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ [/b]Important Notice[/h2][h3][b]Please go to Settings → Input Settings and perform a Key Reset.[/b][/h3][p]Due to upcoming changes for the [b]Controller Update[/b] and key mapping adjustments following the [b]Combat System overhaul[/b],
we highly recommend that [b]existing players reset their key bindings[/b] in the settings before continuing the game.[/p][p]We’re working to ensure that all key assignments function smoothly as soon as possible.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Translation polishing for additional content is currently in progress.[/b][/h3][p]With the addition of various new dialogues, some translations may be incomplete or imperfect.[/p][p]We will update the polished translations as soon as possible.[/p][p]Please keep this in mind while enjoying the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ ⚔️[/b]Combat Overhaul Update Contents[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1.Fairy System Overhaul[/b][/h3][h3]Fairy skills have been reworked.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/8166ece4a820e0269710dbb84969e493511394ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/2e6897f05346db6b9cacabab1769efc319b3f9d6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/82c12b4688c619dab8f9fc9c6bedf4d5e7deaa00.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fairies can now be managed through a new skill menu, allowing for a wide variety of builds.[/p][p]Depending on how you arrange their skills, fairy projectiles can act as homing arrows,
or deal area damage when their shield breaks.[/p][p]Customize your fairy skills to match your own playstyle![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2.Phantom Limb[/b][/h3][h3]The '[i]Phantom Limb[/i] system' has been added.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ba37a78f25fbe5d0fe3243c500b449fd1bc39611.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6e425803509f2bde8b76ce05dadba37f24eaad29.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fairies are helpful on their own,
but they can also possess your hand to lend you their power.[/p][p]This is the [i]Phantom Limb[/i].[/p][p][i]Phantom Limb[/i] transforms your hand into a shield or a wire,
unlocking unique skills and actions.[/p][p]Press [b]T[/b] to transform, [b]Ctrl[/b] to use standard actions,
and [b]Q[/b] to activate Phantom Limb-exclusive skills.[/p][p]Experience a whole new layer of combat with the [i]Phantom Limb[/i]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Phantom Limb: Shield[/b][/h3][h3]Introducing the [b]Shield Mode[/b] of [i]Phantom Limb[/i].[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/724fb9c5e6f58fb048580621f5c83540e5267c19.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/2fd1849fc387e6cbf91605ee2a84b760ac2681d1.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Phantom Limb: Shield[/b] is perfect for players who prefer a defensive combat style.[/p][p]The shield protects you from knockback caused by charge attacks,[/p][p]and its parry ability offers a brief window to counter with massive damage.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Phantom Limb: Wire[/b][/h3][h3]Introducing the [b]Wire Mode[/b] of [i]Phantom Limb[/i].[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6e2bb1ee47896a8ffd38683ffc99466b2328114a.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f87dc9ff3c06c3c7d99d5c4aa9952f13bb7270e6.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Phantom Limb: Wire[/b] is ideal for players who enjoy fast-paced, aggressive combat.[/p][p]Press [b]Ctrl[/b] to shoot the wire—if it hits a monster, you can pull it toward you,
or launch yourself toward the target instead.[/p][p]Surrounded by too many enemies? [/p][p]Use the wire to isolate and drag a specific one right to you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]5. Stability and Execution[/b][/h3][h3]The concepts of [b]Stability[/b] and [b]Execution[/b] have been added.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fb035fcf6b8d3cf52c40c948510ff4b608fa0d59.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/acab28921175a8843dc7cfbf4c4089ff7c1c70c3.gif"][/img][/p][p]All enemies have a stat called [b]Stability[/b].[/p][p]When you attack them, the white gauge decreases—this is their Stability.[/p][p]When an enemy’s Stability is fully depleted, they enter an [b]groggy[/b] state.[/p][p]At this moment, the enemy becomes vulnerable.[/p][p]This is your chance to strike![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/4e3ee9681473f6924caab8b90a3f9039bf463f58.gif"][/img][/p][p]When enemies enter the [b]groggy[/b] state and you have a melee weapon equipped,
you can approach them to attempt an [b]Execution[/b].[/p][p]A special icon will appear when you get close to an [b]groggy[/b] enemy.
Press the attack button while this icon is displayed to trigger the Execution animation.[/p][p]Executions deal powerful damage and will become a key strategic element in your combat![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]6. Player Attack Overhaul[/b][/h3][h3]New attack types are now available for the player.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/b515e61f867eac7da2b551616005a7faf8c93654.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/85ddd4cba895d69445679512dc433cb1b3ef4df9.gif"][/img][/p][p]Tired of just mashing the attack button?[/p][p]We’ve added more variety to the player’s attack options![/p][olist][*][p]Basic attack with a simple click[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy attack with [b]Shift + Click[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Jump attack with [b]Jump + Shift + Click[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p]These three attack types offer a more tactical combat experience.[/p][p]Also, dodge roll animations have been improved to smoothly match your movement direction.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]7.Monster Improvements (Behavior, Detection, Assassination)[/b][/h3][h3]Monster AI has been improved, and a new detection system has been added.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9fb08403f4d5aebac86773da6c57bc841a448b99.gif"][/img][/p][p]Gone are the days when monsters had eyes in the back of their heads and instantly countered with a charge attack the moment you got close.[/p][p]Now, monsters will patrol, rest, and only engage after spotting you and assessing the situation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c76c68a5cf4a8fced1ee4782765fdd9f0bc57aec.gif"][/img][/p][p]With the AI improvements, monsters now truly have “eyes”![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/954acb1b7c2d18b20a4a813ce4b1b653ef1adaf0.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/18cdf9eda6c9c7d33e350393bfe4bc04e14218f0.gif"][/img][/p][p]Monsters now have a clear field of vision and will search for anything that enters it.[/p][p]If the detection eye fully opens, it means the monster has fully spotted you.[/p][p]Sneak up from behind and become a legendary assassin of [i]Luminora[/i]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ General Update Contents[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1. Armor , Weapon Stand[/b][/h3][h3]So we added new furniture items have been added: the [b]Armor Stand[/b] and the [b]Weapon Stand[/b].[/h3][p]You can now showcase your gear and easily swap between displayed equipment and what you're currently wearing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/057b6d879ec8b32d9cddffbb09887ec3a90a547b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/66547dffb8e59388506a63c4ccf19886e8c8981a.gif"][/img][/p][p]In future updates, you’ll often find yourself needing to swap gear depending on the situation—
to stay warm, explore the ocean, or counter specific monsters with the right weapon.[/p][p]To prepare for that, we’ve added a new structure: the [b]Armor Stand[/b] and [b]Weapon Stand[/b]![/p][p]But these aren’t just for display—
they let you preview the expected stats when wearing the gear,
and instantly swap your current equipment with the displayed set.[/p][p]Decorate your home with stylish gear stands and get ready for anything![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2.Story Collection[/b][/h3][h3]Note items can now be added to your [b]Story Collection[/b].[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/23bc9f84e5a42d539abb6dd98f0f9ba80b02090f.png"][/img][/p][p]By popular request, notes can now be added to your [b]Story Collection[/b]![/p][p]Once you've read a note, it will automatically be registered in the collection.[/p][p]But don't worry—the note won’t disappear.[/p][p]That would be inefficient, right?[/p][p]After it's registered, feel free to dismantle the note and collect useful materials![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ [/b]Other Update Contents[/h2][list][*][p]All fuel-consuming structures now have an On/Off toggle function.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/e960483cb151c437c3a68e49f159c4d96b336cc2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New furniture items featuring monster head decorations have been added.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/df6cee2a151eae539de16ef3faa0168ac5af8396.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Damage balance for all weapons has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fairy dialogue has been revised.[/p][p](Look forward to the upcoming story updates!)[/p][/*][*][p]The dialogue display system for NPC interactions has been updated.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Upcoming Added and Changed Content[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Polearm attack animations are scheduled to be updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Execution, heavy attack, and jump attack animations will be revised for each weapon type.[/p][/*][*][p]Mid-boss monsters will receive significant animation changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Awkward player animations will be greatly improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Overall graphics will be enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Detailed balancing work will be done on all weapons’ damage, poise, and stamina mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][/h2][h2]■ Hotfix Details[/h2][h3][b]🔧 \[Changes & notes.title: 06/18 Developer's Letter
notes.content:
[h2][b]🏴‍☠️ Hello, Everyone[/b][/h2][p]I'm Cho, CEO of POLYMORPH.[/p][p]Today, I’m writing to you not as a developer or a CEO, [/p][p]but as a fellow traveler in the long journey of [i]IfSunSets[/i].[/p][p]On behalf of the entire team, I want to express our heartfelt gratitude. [/p][p]Whether you’ve shared your thoughts, left a review, or simply explored our world—we see you, [/p][p]and we thank you. It’s because of you that we’re still here, still building, and still dreaming.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Your Voice Is Our Compass[/b][/h3][p]In uncharted waters, we’ve had one guiding light: your voices.[/p][p]Every suggestion, every note of encouragement, and even the toughest criticisms—we’ve heard it all. We’ve read every word and held onto every story. [/p][p]Some changes you’ve asked for may take time. [/p][p]Others are already underway. [/p][p]But know this: [b]everything we’re doing is built on the foundation of your feedback.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/de27f5fbc83ac35773f5fcac8ffb736b7636da8d.png"][/img]<Your voices are all being heard and recorded>[/p][p][/p][p]You’ve been our North Star, and we’re charting this course together.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Combat Is Being Completely Reimagined[/b][/h3][p]You told us where the combat fell short—shallow depth, missing stealth, limited weapon variety, a fairy system that felt disconnected, and AI that didn’t hold up. Rather than patching over the cracks, we’re rebuilding from the ground up.[/p][p]What’s changing?[/p][list][*][p]Each weapon will have its own unique combat style.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re introducing a new system: [b]Phantom Limbs[/b], unlocking new layers of strategy.[/p][/*][*][p]Parrying, executions, and tactical skill expression will finally come alive.[/p][/*][*][p]AI is getting smarter, deadlier—and more fun to fight.[/p][/*][/list][p]It won’t be flawless at first. But we’re committing to an evolving system that can grow with you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/ba37a78f25fbe5d0fe3243c500b449fd1bc39611.gif"][/img][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/6e425803509f2bde8b76ce05dadba37f24eaad29.gif"][/img][/p][p]<A new form of combat: Phantom Limb is coming soon!>[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/ed6d028e2a6f1b5d69c1a9fb6707fd3c18b73a41.gif"][/img][/p][p]<We're enhancing the thrill of parrying.>[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/ed1c7fde629f30fe5a3c933d2d78e00809929b9f.gif"][/img][/p][p]<Combat will become much more diverse.>[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Fairies Are Becoming True Partners[/b][/h3][p]We heard you loud and clear—our fairies deserved better.[/p][p]They’ll now have [b]skill trees[/b], [b]distinct combat roles[/b], and [b]deeper customization[/b]. [/p][p]They’re no longer just passive companions—they’re your allies. [/p][p]They’ll grow with you, fight with you, and become part of your journey in a meaningful way.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/8166ece4a820e0269710dbb84969e493511394ee.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/2e6897f05346db6b9cacabab1769efc319b3f9d6.png"][/img]<The Fairy will gain a new skill tree.>[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Controller Support Is Coming[/b][/h3][p]Yes, we’re working on full controller support![/p][p]More than just enabling it, we’re optimizing for [b]comfort[/b], [b]intuitive control[/b], [/p][p]and a seamless experience across input devices. [/p][p]Whether you prefer a mouse or a joystick, [i]IfSunSets[/i] will feel right in your hands.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/decd2d13a33b47b09dc87fdd8847e638af5f6243.gif"][/img][/p][p]<Controller support is being developed smoothly.>[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]No Detail Is Too Small[/b][/h3][p]It’s not just the big systems—we’re polishing the smallest corners too.[/p][p]Here are just a few of the updates in progress:[/p][list][*][p]Collection note registration[/p][/*][*][p]Cosmetic overlays[/p][/*][*][p]Campfire/furnace toggle options[/p][/*][*][p]Animal Trophy crafting and custom placement[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory sorting[/p][/*][*][p]Smarter key binding options[/p][/*][/list][p]Every click, every menu, every moment—we want it to feel just right.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/ce1ad13cab8f8e83ea9e3bbf0ea624ca65897033.png"][/img]<Appearance customization will be added soon.>[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/23bc9f84e5a42d539abb6dd98f0f9ba80b02090f.png"][/img]<The Story Archive will be added soon.>[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/df6cee2a151eae539de16ef3faa0168ac5af8396.png"][/img]<Monster head trophies will be added soon.>[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/e960483cb151c437c3a68e49f159c4d96b336cc2.png"][/img]<All fuel-consuming workbenches will soon have an on/off system.>[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]From Knowing Nothing to Here[/b][/h3][p]When we first began building [i]IfSunSets[/i], we had no background in game development.[/p][p]We didn’t even know what a game engine really was. [/p][p]We learned by translating documentation, reverse-engineering examples, [/p][p]and experimenting late into the night. One small step at a time, we taught ourselves everything.[/p][p]We stumbled. We almost gave up—more than once. [/p][p]But through every setback, your encouragement pulled us forward.[/p][p]Now, here we are. Not at the finish line, but proudly at the midpoint. [/p][p]And that’s something we owe entirely to you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]“Now Is the Time to Polish, Not Expand”[/b][/h3][p]That quote came from one of you, and it hit us hard.[/p][p]You’re right. It’s not about stuffing in more content—it’s about refining what we have. We’re not abandoning new content, but we are shifting our focus. We want each system to feel robust and meaningful before adding more.[/p][p]We want to make something that doesn’t just end, but [b]endures[/b]. Something global. Something real.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]So We Made a Big Decision[/b][/h3][p]To do all this—to rebuild, refine, and grow—we needed more than time. We needed resources. Early Access alone wasn’t enough.[/p][p]So, I made a personal choice: [b]I took out a mortgage on my home to fund this vision.[/b][/p][p]Thankfully, Smilegate stepped in to support us as well. That funding allowed us to:[/p][list][*][p]Expand the development team[/p][/*][*][p]Build a proper animation pipeline[/p][/*][*][p]Set up internal QA and stress-testing processes[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s a risk. But we believe it’s one worth taking.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]And We Promise[/b][/h3][p]Here’s what’s ahead:[/p][list][*][p][b]July[/b] – Combat overhaul goes live[/p][/*][*][p][b]October[/b] – Maritime content update[/p][/*][*][p]More updates after that, each building on the last[/p][/*][/list][p]The early stages may feel rough. But we’ll listen, iterate, and improve—together. And years from now, we hope this is a game you still return to. Not just for content drops, but for gameplay that makes your heart race.[/p][p]As always, we ask ourselves again.[/p][quote][p][i]“Is this what our players truly want?”[/i][/p][/quote][p]That question is our compass. And your voice will continue to guide us forward.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]And the Journey Ahead..[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/e555dc50d50271660f3ffabc5f942371302a355e.png"][/img][/p][p]We won’t stop we cross them out and [i]IfSunSets[/i] becomes what it’s meant to be.[/p][p]We hope that when you look back on this game, you’ll think:[/p][quote][p]“A new, trustworthy developer was born here.”[/p][/quote][p]Thank you for walking with us, believing in us, and being patient through it all.[/p][p][/p][p]On behalf of the [i]IfSunSets[/i] development team,[/p][p]- Cho, CEO of Polymorph Studios -[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]P.S.[/b][/h3][p][b]Director Chae just had a baby![/b][/p][p]The studio’s first baby—our tiniest crew member yet.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43578563/bf77c1178d0267f4934c526dead94f0abddf420d.png"][/img]He’s adorable, he’s inspiring, and he’s a reminder of why this journey matters.[/p][p]So here’s to sleepless nights, new beginnings, and even bigger dreams.[/p][p]Go daddy![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 06/04 Hotfix
notes.content:
[b][h1]■ Update Version: v0.5.7[/h1][/b]


Hello, dear pirates!
This is the IfSunSets development team.

We’d like to share news of a recent hotfix.
We’ve been actively listening to your feedback through Discord and various community forums.

At the moment, we’re focusing our efforts on preparing a major content update, which means we aren’t able to deliver frequent hotfixes as quickly as before. We kindly ask for your understanding.

We’re doing our best to bring you even more exciting and meaningful content in the near future.
Thank you always for your support and passion!




[b][h2]■ Major Hotfix Details[/h2][/b]
[u][b]We’ve improved the French, Portuguese, and Spanish localizations for our game, IfSunSets.[/b][/u]

[u][b]We have added a "Special Equipment Slot" that allows you to separate the glider from the backpack.[/b][/u]


[b][h2]■ Hotfix Details[/h2][/b]
[b][h3][Changes][/h3][/b][list]
[*] Added a tooltip to make it easier to understand how to use the Delivery Box.
[*] Added sound effects to improve the feel when moving items in the hotbar.
[*] Adjusted the gunfire effect of the Daywalker Marauder to appear more natural.
[*] Adjusted the volume of sounds played when using the Misc Bench.

Ahoy Pirates!
We’d like to inform you about a recent issue affecting visual performance in IfSunSets.

[h2]■ Known Issue: Sky Graphics Display Problem[/h2]
We've identified a graphical bug where the sky may appear broken or visually distorted during gameplay.

[h3]This issue appears to primarily affect systems using AMD graphics cards.[/h3]

We truly apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience while we work to resolve it.

notes.title: 🌸'LIFE' Update🌸
notes.content:
[b][h1]■ Update Version:: v0.5.0[/h1][/b]

Hello,
This is the IfSunSets development team.
The new update, "Life," has been released!
Check out the new content that matches the theme of "Life!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/5d612e4d4493a8990e25ef9e1efc9a317438aa15.png[/img]



[h2]■ Important Announcements[/h2]
[b]1. We have identified an issue where certain antivirus programs create firewalls that interfere with game access.[/b]
If you are unable to connect to multiplayer, we recommend closing your antivirus software and restarting the game.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Thank you for your understanding.


[b]2. We had no choice but to reset all boss respawn timers to fix a respawn bug.[/b]
Players who had only three days left for a boss respawn have also been affected, so please keep this in mind while playing.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

[b]3. The If Sunset prologue has been updated.[/b]
The prologue offers a preview of what you can experience in the main game.
Please note that some content is restricted in the prologue, unlike the main game.


[h2]■ Key Updates for "Life"[/h2]


[h2]Farming[/h2]
Farming in IFSS has been completely revamped!
Enjoy a more user-friendly UI, a greater variety of crops,
and new buildings to make farming even easier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/42e1516799b9d73df31d236d88a99b8f4faa184a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 17 new crops have been added.
[*] 17 new seeds have been introduced.
[*] Attribute fruits that grant buffs based on their properties have been developed.
[*] Crops now grow based on in-game days rather than real-time progression.
[*] Crop growth time is displayed in the UI when aiming at planted crops.
[*] Soil moisture levels (whether water is sufficient or lacking) are now displayed in the UI when aiming at farmland.
[*] Fertilizer status (whether the soil has fertilizer or not) is now displayed in the UI when aiming at farmland.
[*] "Ktuga Resonator" has been added—a device that emits energy to activate automation structures.
[*] "Seed Generator" has been added—it converts crops into seeds. It requires a Ktuga Resonator to function.
[*] "Sprinkler" has been added—it automatically waters the field in the morning. It requires a Ktuga Resonator to function.
[*] "Energy Farm" has been added—it automatically harvests crops in the morning and stores them in a chest. It requires a Ktuga Resonator to function.
[*] "Streetlight" has been added—it emits bright light by receiving energy from the Ktuga Resonator.
[*] "Delivery Box" has been added—it automatically sells stored crops in the morning.
[/list]



[h2]Livestock[/h2]
Animal friends are coming to IfSunSets!
Manage their happiness and obtain new items from them.
And if necessary, you can also harvest meat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/84af8474bb8f20eafab569544d8c8b8377bdfece.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f3037462d343ad7106e81e90eff7a93389f2598e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fcf77eeb55cd91d41df0b37d1af6eb167b56d845.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9be3df98b67c8fcbe3d43c271ac9fb852d83a6b3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A new livestock system has been developed in IfSunSets.
[*] A total of 5 adult animals and 5 juvenile animals have been added.
[*] Animals can be raised by registering them in feeding troughs and chicken coops.
[*] Animals can be purchased from Laura, or if two adult animals of different genders are registered, they can produce offspring.
[*] Juvenile animals can grow into adults once they accumulate enough growth points.
[*] Animals can be butchered to obtain meat and bones.
[*] Each animal, when happy enough, will produce special items through unique behaviors.
[*] Sheep produce wool.
[*] Pigs produce various types of mushrooms.
[*] Cows produce manure, which serves as fertilizer for farming.
[*] Dairy cows produce milk.
[*] Chickens produce feathers, and hens will lay eggs if a rooster is present.
[*] Extremely happy hens may occasionally lay golden eggs.
[*] All animals have special variants that produce unique items.
[*] Animals can be enclosed by constructing fences around them.
[*] All animals can be given names.
[*] Hitting an animal decreases its happiness.
[*] Chicken feed, called "Grain Mix," can be crafted with 2 wheat or purchased from NPCs.
[*] Hay, the feed for sheep, pigs, and cows, can be obtained by growing Timothy grass or purchased from NPCs.
[*] New livestock equipment sets have been added to improve efficiency: Apprentice Livestock Gear and Professional Livestock Gear.
[/list]


[h2]Fishing[/h2]
A new fishing bait system, fishing points, new fish species,
and a fish farm that allows fish to multiply are being added in the update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6105ef1880875267fa7d1a80e74593e27def0d9e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f2d62756fcaf2e20911842375e8eedc93e726497.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fishing in IfSunSets has been revamped.
[*] Fish now spawn appropriately in rivers, seas, and ponds.
[*] Special fish that can only be caught at night have been added.
[*] Bait has been introduced.
[*] If bait is in your inventory, you can switch it using the "R" key, just like swapping arrows.
[*] A new "Fish Farm" has been added, where placing two of the same type of fish may result in one additional fish appearing the next day.
[*] A "Matter Converter" has been added, which transforms trash into a random general material item overnight. The Matter Converter requires a Ktuga Resonator to function.
[*] Two new fishing rods have been added.
[*] Nine new fish species have been added.
[/list]



[h2]Research Notes[/h2]
The Research Note System is being updated!
Register items, earn new rewards, and upgrade your life in IfSunSets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/0982f7dcf285796f839b9451b258de3af6f0e080.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6089cd2be3d4512a0e1dff72713e2fcc8b579a6f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Research Notes have been added to IfSunSets.
[*] They can be accessed by talking to Laura, Logan, and Aiden.
[*] There are three types of research notes: Crop Research, Ichthyology Research (Fish Study), and Animal Research.
[*] By providing the requested items, players can earn experience points and unlock new blueprints.
[*] As the research level increases, both difficulty and rewards will grow.
[*] Completing all research notes will grant a final reward.
[/list]



[h2]Construction[/h2]
94 new interior furniture items are being added in bulk!
Furniture can be purchased from NPCs or crafted directly.
Decorate your home beautifully!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/bcbbe0625dd4a9978f1a9c1102714dcb37098def.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 1x1 stairs have been adjusted to align in a straight line, allowing seamless connections.
[*] 1x1 cubes and 2x2 cubes can now be placed on the ground.
[*] Logic optimization has been improved.
[*] The appearance of some module types has been updated.
[*] A total of 94 new furniture items have been added for home decoration.
[*] Having furniture in your home now provides buffs that assist in exploration.
[/list]



[h2]Music Performance[/h2]
A Guitar Bench construction has been added, allowing you to play beautiful music.
The Guitar Bench can be crafted at the workbench, placed in the world, and interacted with.
Play your favorite music freely!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f6a28187c30715adc92df4f938dde7684802a53b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A guitar system that allows freeform playing has been added!
[*] To use the guitar, craft a "Guitar Bench," place it in the world, and interact with it.
[/list]




[h2]■ Bug Fix[/h2]


[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some items did not grant material items when dismantled.
[*] Fixed an issue where the crafting requirements for certain items were displayed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed item duplication through specific methods.
[*] Fixed an issue where destroying chests did not provide materials.
[*] Fixed an issue where wells appeared abnormally when destroyed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effect played twice when monsters were defeated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the color of crab monsters changed upon defeat.
[*] Fixed an issue where the number of ballista bolts did not reset when retrying the Worm Boss fight.
[*] Fixed an issue where controls became unresponsive upon death during the Worm Boss fight.
[*] Fixed an issue where interacting with the boss altar while performing another action made further interactions impossible.
[*] Fixed an issue where bosses did not respawn in certain worlds.
[*] Fixed an issue where gaps were present in some maps.
[*] Fixed an issue where incorrect information was displayed in the compendium.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain monsters did not appear in the compendium even after being defeated.
[/list]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players occasionally entered the wrong world when joining a multiplayer session.
[*] Fixed an issue where castle traps did not function correctly for guest players.
[*] Fixed an issue where guest players' FOV settings were reset.
[*] Fixed an issue where tombstones spawned inside the boss room when dying during a boss fight.
[*] Fixed an issue where interacting with water in multiplayer allowed multiple interactions.
[*] Fixed an issue where rescuing NPCs displayed incorrect language.
[*] Fixed an issue where quests that did not meet the completion conditions were marked as completed.
[/list]




[b]We are continuously working on fixing crashes and errors in the game[/b]

If you experience any issues after the patch, please tell us in our discord.
Your feedback is always welcome. You can write your feedback on Steam or Discord.

Discord: https://discord.gg/Ifsunsets

Bug report form [url=https://ripple-lamp-d9f.notion.site/Bug-Report-9cb993ba435b4c9ca7fae3d4541f2499](link)[/url]

notes.title: [2/28] 4-Player Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Ahoy Pirates!

Thanks to all the support and sincere feedback from everyone who joined us so far during the first months of the Early Access phase.
We are proud to announce that IfSunSets is finally [u]fully supporting 4-player multiplayer[/u].

Now, you can experience even more intense, strategic, and fun survival gameplay with your friends, colleagues, and family. We deeply apologize for the long waiting time you all had to endure.

As always, we will continue to listen to your feedback and grow IfSunSets together with you. 
Your feedback is always welcome. We will never ignore it and will carefully consider everything!

The reward will be the updates our community is asking for. We are committed to making IfSunSets a wonderful experience for all of you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/565a0b2ccbbc1d6ba0e9556f6abda1f356d31aee.jpg[/img][h1]■ Update Version:: v0.4.9[/h1]
[h2]4-Player-Multiplayer Support[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed Multiplayer from a maximum of 2 players to a maximum of 4 players.
[/list][h2]■ Party System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a party system for the 4-player multiplayer support.
[*] Through this system, players can share experience points, monster kills, and more.
[i]The party system is essential for tracking each other's locations and participating in boss battles together.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/45fd40a8f80ed3622a7ea0edfe0b1537f6642a5e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6d10ac0a68fd923f75ec4c90f7aeb223c786a685.png[/img]
[/list][h2]Lock System[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new lock system has been developed to protect your valuable home and treasure chests.
[*] Locks can be installed on chests and doors, preventing interaction with them by anyone other than the owner.
[*] However, party members can still interact with locked chests and doors if permission is granted through the party system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c9a84f1d865021e9e111cf78fdfd32474c53c824.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/172df4f791ea89536070e77fda2735a8b1079364.png[/img]
[/list][h2]New Shared Chest System[/h2]
The long-awaited shared chest system is now live!
[list]
[*] Shared chests will now allow players to share materials better with each other.
[*] Store your materials in the shared chest and feel free to share them with others!
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/eb6642edfcca2b9e71b93d14ba6e630fe6143617.png[/img]
[b]Important Information[/b]
[list]
[*] The teleportation system has been changed for system management purposes.
[*] Disconnect issues may occur intermittently, but a patch will be released soon to improve this.
[*] For optimization purposes, the quest "Records on the Crimson Wetlands" has been temporarily suspended.
[i]We will improve the performance for this quest and plan to activate this quest again with the next update[/i]
[/list][h3][General Bug Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the crafting quantity in the crafting tab to increase only up to the max. craftable amount.
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss Worms repeatedly perform the same actions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss Brown Beard would not attack unless within a specific range.

[*] Fixed an issue where attempting consecutive attacks with a spear drained additional stamina.

[*] Fixed an issue where the character's stat description did not match the actual stat increase.

[*] Fixed an issue where pressing Enter and ESC simultaneously caused the chat to become unusable.
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage values for stealth attack hits did not match the actual damage dealt.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse pointer would not immediately appear after death in the Night of the Dead.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Steel Spear item would fall beneath the ground when dropped.

[*] An issue occurred where cleared dungeons got partly reset and doors, which were opened with keys as well as defused traps were completely reset.

[/list]

We have identified the cause of this issue and a hotfix is scheduled for today.

Please note that data saved after the reset occurred may be difficult to restore. 
We recommend playing the game after the planned hotfix is applied.

[h3][u]If you have already saved your progress, 
we recommend using the backup system after the hotfix to restore your earliest backup data.[/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/068153ad6d3a5cd8f2989e2d6a25b9363ca34f3c.png[/img]

We apologize for any confusion this may have caused during your gameplay.
Thank you for your understanding.

notes.content:
[h1]■ Update Version: v0.4.7[/h1]

[h2]■ Save Data Overhaul[/h2]
In this update, we completely overhauled the system of saving your progress to deal with savefile issues  because of crashes or sudden disconnections.
Because of the savefile changes a savedata migration will be done when having savedata from previous versions of the game.

[h3][u]If your saved data does not appear after launching the game,

[list]
[*] The savefile backup feature is designed to restore previous save data when your character data is lost or your server information is unavailable.
[*] The backup will operate once when the game is launched, and up to 5 backup files will be kept.
[*] Please note that when restoring data using the backup feature, the existing data will be overwritten, so use this feature with caution.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/068153ad6d3a5cd8f2989e2d6a25b9363ca34f3c.png[/img]
[i]* If you encounter any issues with save data migration or the backup feature, please contact us via Discord, and we will respond quickly.[/i]
[h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Amira would sometimes not appear despite being rescued.
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss would not spawn after a certain period of time had passed after being defeated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mount could not be dismounted when consuming food simultaneously.
[*] Fixed an issue where some translations were missing.
[*] Fixed an issue where character information would be displayed even though no save data was present when loading the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where some fairy skills were not functioning as intended while using a mount.
[*] Fixed an issue where wooden barrels in the castle were spawning stacked on top of each other.
[*] Fixed an issue where the fragments from breaking the golden floor tiles would appear incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters would stutter when chasing the player.
[*] Fixed an issue where the fanatic summoning skill was being used repeatedly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tail summon attack of the Boss Worms was triggering incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where, while climbing ladders in the Boss Worms map, the downward motion would occasionally appear.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Boss Worms respawn message was missing.
[*] Fixed an issue where the breath attack of the a Boss occasionally did not register as a hit.
[*] Adjusted the minimum value for shop multipliers in world settings.
[*] Fixed an issue where decorative lamps sold by Lora could not be reclaimed.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could pass through walls when mounting a mount near a wall.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effect from the Sea Slater was not visible.
[*] Fixed an issue where Shadow Wing was moving in backwards.
[*] Fixed an issue where, after crafting an item while the inventory was full, any dropped item would be automatically acquired as a rare item, regardless of conditions.
[*] Reworked the experience distribution logic in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an issue where the creation and update of save files were happening at different times, causing unintended behavior.
[*] Fixed an issue where there was more lag when viewing or playing in the ruins compared to other areas.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when opening the load/save window.
[/list][h3]■ Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the attack of the Twin Witches appeared differently for guests and on the server.
[*] Fixed an issue where, even after destroying the Heart Gem, other players could still destroy it.
[*] Fixed an issue where purified Cthuga stones would disappear when transferring to the inventory from the purification device.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would occasionally fall through the floor during the Iron Heart battle.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could build high structures during the Iron Heart battle, making it easier to defeat Iron Heart.
[*] Fixed an issue where the guest player’s teleportation in the host environment caused the host’s frame rate to drop significantly.
[/list][h3]■ Game Environment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized plants and crops.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain trees, plants, stones, and rocks appeared oddly due to distance.
[/list][h2]■ Known Issues[/h2]
We are investigating following issues.
[list]
[*] Investigating an issue where right-clicking to aim and fire with pistols and rifles causes the aiming state to reset.
[*] Discussing the issue where the rate of fire of pistols is too low, causing balance issues with rifles.
[*] Investigating frame drops during auto-save in single-player/multiplayer worlds.
[*] Checking an issue where field monster respawn times are not functioning as intended.
[*] Analyzing reports of Fatal Errors and LowLevelFatalErrors to prevent recurrence.
[*] Replacing the search function in the multiplayer server search with one that shows servers containing the searched terms, rather than only searching exact matches.
[*] There is an intermittent issue where save data does not appear in-game. This is planned to be fixed with an upcoming update. If this issue occurs now, restarting should resolve the issue.

notes.title: 4 Player Multiplayer (Beta) starts January 23rd
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to bring to you the beta version of the 4 Player Multiplayer. 
Many of you were asking for it and the whole team was focusing on making the 4 Player Multiplayer possible!
Beginning Thursday, when starting the game via Steam, a pop-up window will appear in which our players can choose between "Play IfSunSets" and "4-Player Beta Build (Unstable)".
This option is available for all of our players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/4b6eb0e66318180e3d11b7c952735bfbb38ba629.png[/img]
[b]Play IfSunSets:[/b]
[list]
[*] Starts the Standard Early Access Version of IfSunSets as you know it
[*] Up to 2 Players can play online together
[/list]  
[b]4-Player Beta Build (Unstable):[/b]
[list]
[*] Starts the 4-Player Beta Build of IfSunSets
[*] Up to 4 Players can play online together
[*] [u]Savedata from the Beta is not compatible with the Standard Early Access Version[/u]
[*] [u]Once the Beta concludes, the saved data may no longer be usable.[/u]
[*] Although internal testing did not show any game breaking issues, there might be still some bugs and this version of the game might still be a bit unstable compared to the standard version of IfSunSets.
[/list]  
[i]* Multiplayer between players of the Standard Early Access Version and the Beta is not possible[/i]

The 4 Player Beta Build will be available from Thursday, January 23rd until Wednesday, February 5th.

We hope you all look forward to try out the 4 Player Beta and be able to play IfSunSets with your friends!
Thank you all for supporting us and we will strive to improve the game further.

[list]
[*] NPCs are appearing at the spot where you first met them with reset dialogue, even though they should not be there. 
[*] In-game time is not progressing when loading a save file from an earlier version.
[*] Items registered in the hotbar are returning to the inventory when loading a save.
[*] Some users are experiencing additional stutters in game after the latest hotfix
[/list]

[b]We are currently investigating these issues and another hotfix, which will deal with these issues, will be released today.[/b]

notes.title: 12/06 Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]■ Update Version: v0.3.17[/h1]
[h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]■ Main Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Adjusted the default DirectX Version from 12 to 11 to significantly reduce Fatal Errors and crashes. [/b][i]* In a future update, we will implement the option to choose between DirectX 11 and 12.[/i]
[b][*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash intermittently when large amounts of experience orbs were collected after clearing a Enemy Wave at night.
[*] Fixed an issue where, in multiplayer, the guest (Player 2) would occasionally experience a rollback to a previous save state after dying.
[*] Fixed an issue where orbs had the wrong color which made it impossible to enter a specific area.
[*] Fixed an issue where quest items were missing from gravestones when a player died while holding them.
[*] Fixed an issue where some game mode (difficulty) presets were not functioning correctly in single-player mode.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the largest ship from functioning.
[*] Fixed an issue with abnormal monster spawns near the Golden Wing Tribe Chief's location.
[*] Fixed an issue with key bindings, when the interaction key was changed from F to E, which resulted in the interaction with boxes not functioning correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where the version mismatch warning occasionally did not appear, when entering a multiplayer room.[/b][/list][h3]■ New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a time-limited special "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2271930/view/4453592738017838456]Pioneer Set[/url]" which is available until Dec. 19th
[*] A new "Bag of Peddlers" item has been added. It can be acquired as a drop from certain monsters.
[/list][h3]■ Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mitigated frame drops and frame leaks after playing for a certain period.
[*] Fixed a frame drop issue when looking at specific locations where Iron Heart was located.
[/list][h3]■ Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where items in the shared chest were disappearing when the connection with the host was lost during multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an issue where the guest (Player 2) could not interact with their own shared chest in multiplayer. 
[i]* Currently, each player can own and use one's shared chest. We plan an unified chest in a future update, which allows combined usage.[/i]
[*] Fixed an issue where combining items like arrows and bullets resulted in abnormal materials.
[*] Fixed an issue where, after a the guest (Player 2) left the room, the number of players did not get refreshed, which prevented the guest from re-connection.
[*] Fixed an issue where ladders would sometimes cause players to fall through the floor.
[*] Prevented teleportation when using ladders.
[*] Fixed an issue where the world environment of the guest (Player 2) did not show breaking wooden barrels did not trigger effects, sounds, or debris.
[*] Fixed an issue where moving a building to the hotbar while another building was being constructed caused the building to stop loading and load another building module instead.
[*] Fixed an issue where only parts of a building would be constructed when placing two construction scrolls.
[*] Fixed an issue where effects that should have been deleted after clearing a wave were showing continuously in specific locations.
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing "OK" without binding keys in the keybinding window would make it impossible to bind those keys again.
[*] Mitigated the Fatal Error occurring when entering the jungle at the starting point.
[*] Fixed an issue where abnormal item acquisition could occur when using the cooking pot through specific actions.
[*] Fixed an issue where, in the case of a full inventory, the quest would be completed without providing rewards, and only the quest item was collected.
[*] Fixed an issue where the stats displayed in the skill tree were different from the actual applied stats.
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer where gravestones spawned in a specific place during boss fights after a wipe, making interactions difficult.
[*] Fixed an issue where, after dying, the guest player did not get revived and their gravestone Items, as well as the same items in the inventory were present after a forced closing and rejoining the session.
[*] Fixed an issue where, after 24 hours in multiplayer, the color of skulls displayed on the guest's screen would revert to white.
[*] Fixed an issue where giant enemies summoned during the night wave did move in a abnormal way.
[*] Fixed an issue where cloth reinforcement could not be crafted at stage 4 of the armor crafting station.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the guest (Player 2) from interacting with shared chests in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue where the inventory would open twice and not close properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the acquisition and closing keys on the story note screen were showing default keys instead of the assigned ones.
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing the reset key in input settings did not return the hotbar's 7-9 keys to default.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue where keybindings did not work.
[*] Fixed an issue where cross-play between Players from Steam and STOVE did sometimes not work.
[*] Fixed an issue where death markers appeared at the location of death, instead of the location of th gravestone, when dying in the water.
[*] Fixed an issue where the thorn trap would be built 90° rotated compared to the preview.
[*] Added a warning message when changing the name of a non-owned chest.
[*] Fixed an issue where in some cases the guest (Player 2) in multiplayer could not interact with objects.
[*] Fixed an issue where changing a marker's name on the world map was not applied in real-time.
[*] Fixed an issue where the bed's sleep time was displayed with a wrong value.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "perfect safe landing" skill and other related Falltraining skills were not functioning properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the weapon durability decreased when being hit by attacks from turret projectiles during the night wave.
[*] Fixed an issue where traps appeared differently between the host and the guest in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an issue where characters would show an incorrect level after resurrection in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an issue where Iron Heart's pattern did not change correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters could attack players behind walls.
[*] Fixed an issue where the animation played in reverse when dismounting from an elk.
[*] Fixed an issue where the furnace would not work properly after reconnecting.
[*] Fixed an issue where some monsters appeared within terrain objects.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Night of the Dead enemies would not play their walking animations and did instead slide across the ground.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's character marker would flicker when maintaining a certain distance from animals.

Before we talk about the Bug Fixes today, we want to address some rollback issues, which happen, when exiting Steam during the Steam Cloud Sync process.
If Steam gets closed or the PC gets shut down during the Steam Cloud Synchronization process, Saved data gets rolled back to the last Save, which is synchronized with Steam.
Because of this, we are asking our players to wait some time before closing Steam after exiting the game.
[u][b]After exiting IfSunSets: Please wait until Steam did synchronize all save data, before exiting Steam.[/b][/u]

notes.title: Working on Direct X 11 & Addressing Crashes and Level Reset issues
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone[/h2]
[h3]This is Polymorph.[/h3]
IfSunSets started into Early Access on November 5th and we are happy to see, that more and more people enjoy the game, but we are also aware, that our game still has bugs and problems, which sadly destroys the gameplay experience for some of you.

We are aware that especially the Multiplayer Mode has issues which can cause crashes and even can destroy in some cases save files or change the Level of the Character to a lower level.

We want to apologize for these issues and are working day and night to resolve those issues as soon as possible. 
Our main goal right now is to stabilize the game, especially in Multiplayer.

As you might have noticed, we are putting out hotfixes almost daily and try to fix especially issues like crashes very quickly.
We really want all of you to enjoy the game, but sometimes a hotfix caused another issue which we then have to fix via another hotfix. 
Because of that, another focus for us right now is to spend more time testing, to make sure that hotfixes we upload don’t cause other problems.

We are aware that we have to earn the trust from each of you and it is our goal and responsibility to create a game, players can enjoy. 
So we ask all of you, to give us the chance and some time to make things right and improve the game stability, especially the multiplayer mode.
All of us promised ourselves to be transparent and honest to our community. 
That is why we will discuss three main issues users are experiencing, what the status is of fixing these issues are, and what we kindly ask you, the players, to do, so that you can circumvent some of these problems in the meantime.

[h2][Singleplayer: Item or Level Reset Issue][/h2]
Cases of items or level resets are rare in single-player mode but at least until Version 0.3.11, they happened to some users.
We are reviewing right now the data, if this issue still happens in Version 0.3.12.
[h3][Causes and Countermeasures][/h3]
Previously, when a character died and interacted with the gravestone, a delay would occur during the interaction. If the character died again before finishing the interaction, the item being used at the time would disappear.
[h3]Patch Schedule:[/h3]
We issued a patch on [u]November 19th[/u], which deals with this issue. After this update, items should no longer disappear even if the character dies during this interaction.
If Users still have this Level reset issues in Singleplayer (We discuss Multiplayer down below), then please let us know via Steam Discussions or on Discord.

[h2][Game Crash Issue][/h2]
[h3]Causes:[/h3]
There are multiple potential causes, but internally we have identified some compatibility issues with DirectX 12, optimization and PC specifications as the main factors. 
After switching to DirectX 11, these fatal errors were fixed for many users and reports suggest that the CPU processing became more stable. 
We are currently conducting various tests internally to fully implement DirectX11 support.
[h3]Planned Patch Schedule:[/h3]
[u]We are planning an update for next week[/u]
We are looking into full DX11 support and are optimizing the game to work better DirectX 11, so that we can release a patch which makes the game easily available to play in DirectX 11.
[b]How to play the game in DX11 until the Patch releases:[/b]
For those experiencing "Fatal Errors," try running the game as follows to access Direct11 Mode:
[olist]
[*] Open your Steam Library.
[*] Right-click the game title IfSunSets and select “Properties...”.
[*] In the General tab, find the Launch Options section.
[*] Enter the following command: “-d3d11” or “-dx11” (without quotes).
[*] Close the Properties window and run the game.
[/olist]
*Please be aware that starting the DirectX 11 right now can cause additional minor frame drops and graphic issues. We are working on fixing these issues before officially supporting DirectX 11.

[h2][Multiplayer Instability (Disconnects) + Item and Level Resets][/h2]
[h3]Cause:[/h3]
We found following reasons for this to happen:
[list]
[*] Data loss due to ping differences between the host and guest (Player 2).
[*] Data loss caused by the host's unstable internet connection.
[*] Too much data is being sent to the server at once, resulting in some data being lost.
[*] When the game ends, characters with missing data are saved, which causes a reset for the player (client).
[/list]
To address the data reset issue, we are working on and partly already implemented the following adjustments:
[list]
[*] Simplification and optimization of save data. 
[*] Increase in packet size (data size), so that the all data can be transmitted at once. 
[*] Development of a system to more efficiently compress game data / user data before transferring it.
[*] Getting rid of data loss caused by ping differences by extending loading times.
[/list]
[h3]Patch Schedule:[/h3]
We applied a fix which deals with the Level Reset and Item Reset issue yesterday (Version 0.3.12).
The Data we received so far suggests that this fixed reset issues for most players. We are still monitoring the situation and savefiles created before this Hotfix was applied could have corrupted data.
We were not able to fix the disconnection errors yet and we are working relentlessly on it. We are planning to be able to improve this issue by next week.
[h3]Preventive Measures (just to be save):[/h3]
[u]we still recommend backing up your character save files before entering the game:[/u]
Navigate to the following Folder %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\IFSS\Saved\.
[u]Back up the character save files + GameSettings.sav file in the SaveGames folder[/u]
[u]It is recommended to back up the entire SaveGames folder if possible.[/u]
However, since single-player and multiplayer are saved as separate files but are all addressed by the GameSettings.sav, progress may be lost during the process of overwriting backup files.
By providing the save file name, guide them to back up individual files separately.
In this case, errors may occur when creating or deleting new characters (both in single-player and multiplayer).
This way, if any issues occur, you can restore your character.

We know that this is a lot to ask from our players at this moment, but we promise to update the game often to provide you a great experience on the island of Luminora.

notes.title: A Message To Our Players!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Pirates![/h2]

This is the IfSunSets Team.

We want to sincerely thank you all for joining the Early Access of IfSunSets. 
Our goal is to provide an enjoyable experience for our players, but we want to apologize for the frustrating experiences caused by several critical bugs many of you experienced.
It seems that, in our eagerness to deliver a great game before launch, we overlooked some important aspects.
Moving forward, we will approach our updates with more caution and will carefully reviewing and check everything before release.
We also want to express our heartfelt gratitude to those who have played our game despite its "rough edges", and especially to everyone who has shared their feedback, pointed out areas for improvement, reported bugs, and supported us in the community we want to say thank you. 
We truly appreciate all of you!

[h2]Current Status and Plans for the Future[/h2]
Most critical bugs that previously made playing the game impossible have now been resolved.  
We are now focusing on fixing uncomfortable gameplay bugs and issues that occur on some specific devices, with the goal of improving the overall experience for all of your.  

[h3]Our commitment for November[/h3]
[b]Our first commitment is to ensure Full Stabilization of the 2-player Multiplayer by November.[/b] 
The multiplayer experience is steadily improving and thanks to your detailed feedback, we are able to fix different issues appearing in the game. 
It is clear to us that without your help, we wouldn’t have been able to make this much progress.
Our development team has always wanted to create a game that friends, couples, families, and loved ones can enjoy together. 
Multiplayer is the foundation of this vision. 
[u]We promise to stabilize the 2-player multiplayer mode[/u] so that it can be enjoyed seamlessly by the end of November.  

[h3]Our commitment for December[/h3]
Our second major commitment is that [u]in December, we will expand the  multiplayer max. player count to 4[/u]. 
We know many of you have expressed disappointment that multiplayer is limited to 2 players at this stage. 
[b]After stabilizing the multiplayer experience, expanding the player count to 4 will be our top priority![/b]
By the end 2024, we plan to allow 4 players to explore Island of Luminora together. 
We also hope to make IfSunSets a game that allows not only 4 players but even more players in the future.

[h3]Our commitment for the future of IfSunSets [/h3]
We will gradually update the content of IfSunSets that we have yet to show you.

[h2]Roadmap Preview:[/h2]
[b]There is a lot we have planned to make the world of IfSunSets even bigger![/b]
Here is a little preview of what to come.
[list]
[*] A massive underwater dungeon full of secrets, located under the sea  
[*] Vastly improving the shipbuilding and let you sail with your companions
[*] Several additional islands, each filled with treasures.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/57941b3250c67a00b8841e11ede2331f6299133b.jpg[/img]

More details will be shared via our roadmap later this month. 
After that, we’ll introduce [u]Medias[/u], the ultimate boss for IfSunSets.  
To defeat Medias, you will need to use all the skills you have learned throughout your journey.

[h2]Thank you, Pirates![/h2]
Although we are still in Early Access, your feedback has given us the confidence that we can create the complete game we’ve always dreamed of. If our game continues to improve, it will be thanks to all of you.  
Have you all pressed the "M" key to have a loot at the map?  
That map you see will be filled with more adventures and stories.
And this map will even expand!

Defeating Medias will not be the end – a whole new world will unfold before you. 
We are aiming to complete an Game that can be enjoyed infinitely.

We will be sharing our detailed roadmap very soon.  
Please look forward to the future of IfSunSets.

Thank you once again!
