notes.title: Known Issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
here is a list of Known Issues found while playing Early Access of IfSunSets.
We are hard at work to get rid of all issues as soon as we can and we will keep this list up to date!

If you want to make a bug report, please go to the support page on our homepage:
https://ifsunsets-polymorph-studios.com/

※ Please don’t load save files from Prologue or Beta Test! 
-	Start a new game and don’t use save files which were created with the Prologue or the Beta Test of the build. Trying to load into one of these save files will lead to bugs, which will make the game unplayable.

[h2]These are the known issues:[/h2]
We are looking into all of these and try to fix them as soon as we can.

[b]Connection issues due to Auto-Save[/b]
There is an issue which causes disconnections due to World Auto-Save by the host.
We are looking into the issue right now but for now we ask People who are the Host in Game [u]not to use the Auto-Save feature right now.[/u]

[b]Log-In Issue on Epic Online Services:[/b] [i]Thanks to the user Trest[/i]
If you cannot log in into Epic Online Services (EOS) please try the following:
- While the Game is running open the Task Manager (Ctrl + Alt + Delete)
- Close the EOS Backround Progress (Epic Online Services Overlay)
- try to go into Multiplayer again
This method helped some users to log in to Epic Games Online Services again.

[b][Crash] Fatal Error[/b]
Some people are having a fatal error when trying to start the game.
[u]Here is a possible fix for some players:[/u] ([i]Thanks to the User Wholf[/i])
[olist]
[*] Launch the game via DirectX 11
[*] Open your Steam library.
[*] Right-click the game title and select Properties.
[*] Under the General tab, locate the Launch options section.
[*] Enter this command: -d3d11 OR this command: -dx11
[*] Close the Properties window and launch the game.
[/olist][i]*If this doesn’t resolve the issue, return to Properties, go to the Installed Files tab, and select Verify integrity of game files. This will check and restore any missing or corrupted files. Once completed, try launching the game again.[/i]

[b][Settings] A performance issue related to the 'Soft Lock Activation' setting has been discovered[/b]
[list]
[*] For players experiencing significant delays when hitting monsters, it is recommended to turn off the 'Soft Lock Activation' feature.
[/list][b]A bug appeared, which allows three people to play together in multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Since the savedata is stored separately, there should be no issues with the save files.
[*] However, in the current version, the game is very unstable if three people enter the same room. This may lead to more errors such as game crashes, so please play only up to two people.
[*] [u]This bug does not appear in room which are protected by a password. Please make sure to set a password![/u]
[/list]
[b][Multiplayer] Client Crashing When having a big Save Data[/b]
[list]
[*] When a player has acquired over 90% of skills, completed over 90% of quests and tutorials, learned all fairy skills, expanded the inventory to the maximum, and filled the inventory with all items, the game will crashes upon respawning after death.
[*] Currently, some progress has been made in resolving this issue, but it cannot be considered completely fixed yet.
[*] Although it's not expected that users will quickly accumulate such data in the late game, we plan to address this issue with a hotfix within a week.
[/list]
[b][Multiplayer] Intermittent Client Crashing[/b]
[list]
[*] There are still random client crashes that occur completely at random. Sometimes there are no crashes for 3-4 hours, while other times it may crash after just one hour. Because it happens randomly, we are working internally to identify the cause, and we will resolve it as soon as the cause is determined.
[/list]
[b]Translation Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Different translation errors for some languages. 
[/list]

with a short left mouse klick you can do standard attacks and with a long left mouse click you can start special attacks.

notes.title: Making Exploring at night more exciting!
notes.content:
Only 3 days left until IfSunSets goes into Early Access.

Today we want to show you the improvements we made to make exploring at night more exciting!

[h2]Night Defense System Overhaul:[/h2]
[h3]New level scaling system:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The difficulty of the enemy-waves at night will influenced by the players level instead of increasing day-by-day.
[*] If you die too many times, the difficulty at night will be automatically decreased.
[/list][h3]Night Reward System Overhaul:[/h3]
We will introduce new rewards, which will be only obtainable during the night. This way you don't only have to fear the next night, but also can look forward to what loot you might be able to get.
[h3]Further Improvements for the night system:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies at night will start destroying your building if you flee into the water.
[*] The sea water is cold at night. If you flee into the water at night, you will get damage.
[*] Exploding enemies will cause area damage but the damage area will not go behind walls.
[*] Giant Enemies are prioritizing destroying your constructions and buildings over the player. You should destroy them as fast as possible, when they appear.
[/list][h2]Cthugha Flower:[/h2]
There is a new mystical Flower, which is called Cthugha Flower and it produces Cthugha Stones. 
These flowers only bloom at night. 
So now you have a new reason to explore Luminora at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/be2a683db9983147a8f724df11093885a9abcf40.png[/img]
[h2]Cthugha Cores:[/h2]
We added new Cthugha Cores, which are hidden around the island.
With these Cthugha Cores, your fairy can instantly receive exp. 
Keep your eyes open!

We are working day and night to polish the game even further and we have still some improvements to announce in the next few days.

notes.title: Differences between Beta and Early Access Release version
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
[b]The release of the Early Access Version for IfSunSets is almost here.[/b]

[h2]New features + many improvements[/h2]
We have been hard at work and used your beta test feedback to improve the game, give our players more options and fix diverse bugs.
Players who tried out our Beta or played the Prologue Demo before will experience a lot of improvements.
From the new options to customize your playthrough, over an overhauled Skill System to changes in combat.
[h2]Multiplayer [BETA] (Up to 2 players)[/h2]
There is also one change between the Open Beta and the Release Version of the Early Access we sadly have to announce today.
[b]The multiplayer on release of Early Access will allow up 2 players.[/b]
During the Beta Test, there have been many complaints and inquiries regarding the multiplayer.
So we put our focus on fixing these issues and addressed over 800 bugs!

However, with improving the quest progress and various new features in IfSunSets, new issues occurred which make the multiplayer more unstable if more than two players take part in multiplayer. 
Therefore, we had to reduce the number of players until we can resolve this issue after the Early Access Release.
From the deepest of our hearts, we want to apologize for this.

We want to be transparent and be clear, that at release of Early Access the Multiplayer will still have some issues left and will be in Beta state. Multiplayer improvements are our highest priority right now and we work every day on improving the multiplayer experience.

[b]Now we will discuss the improvements from Beta to Early Access Release of IfSunSets[/b]

[h1][Contents][/h1]
[h2]Skill System Overhaul:[/h2]
The entire skill system of the game has been revamped and the skill tree has completely changed. 
You will be able to improve your character in various ways which allows different playstyles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/92507c874ae2e441f39272b95bb80fc0cdaea960.png[/img][list]
[*] The new Skill System allows way more flexibility!
[*] We are also introducing Special Attacks for different weapons, which will make the combat more fun!
[*] The Balancing will be also improved. [i](Balancing changes are made with community feedback in mind.)[/i]
[*] More details coming soon!
[/list][h2]Improved Night System:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We added a new reason to explore the island at night, while we kept the intensity of the combat during that time!
[*] different gameplay improvements which allow a more enjoyable battle system
[*] more details about the improved Night System will come tomorrow, so stay tuned.
[/list][h2]More Traps:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New turrets, which fire bullets at monsters have been added.
[*] We are introducing traps, which push enemies away to prevent them from coming too close.
[*] Many more new traps are coming
[/list][h2]Lore Video sequences:[/h2]
Video sequences have been added to introduce the Lore of IfSunSets. 
You can watch this video when starting a new game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/46ab3f9aec021108ee117c5dbdf682d210a0c596.png[/img]
[h2]New Game Modes:[/h2]
There are now three difficulty levels available when starting a new game:
[b]Easy, Medium and Hard![/b]
There are two more modes available where players can customize their playthrough the way they want.
If you don't want monsters to appear at night, use the SAFE NIGHT MODE. 
If you want to edit everything in the game, use the CUSTOM MODE. Create your own world!
[h1][System][/h1]
[h2]Steam Achievements:[/h2]
Steam achievements have been created! 
There are currently 11 achievements you can get, but we plan to add more in the future.
[h2]Credits added:[/h2]
You can now see the credits, where the people who worked on the game are listed.
Including the developers, our partners and other people we are thankful to.

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]
[list]
[*] We have addressed several key issues causing Fatal Errors which were reported during the beta test. 
If Fatal Errors occur again, please report them, and we will definitely resolve these issues as well.
[*] Fixed issues where certain elements in the tutorial were not pre-checked.
[*] Fixed a bug with the fairy skill "Blifia Bomb" that prevented the skill from activating in specific situations, causing it to get stuck.
[*] Resolved the Ultra Black Shadow Bug, which made all shadow deep black.
[*] Fixed a bug where items disassembled from the hotbar would be removed but remain equipped, allowing for infinite use.
[*] Corrected an issue where items would drop on the ground instead of being obtained if the inventory was full, even with available hotbar slots.
[*] Fixed various bugs occurring at the puzzle before the boss fight 
(such as issues with saving or problems interacting with the puzzle).
[*] Fixed a problem where all items would disappear when respawning after death and loading a save in front of the gravestone.
[*] We have addressed many different bugs which were reported via Discord, Steam and our survey during the Beta Test.

[h3]That is everything for now![/h3]
We want to thank everyone who gave feedback during the beta once more and we will work hard during the early access period to improve the gameplay, fix issues, add new features and much more.
We are listening to our community and your honest feedback is always welcome!
You can write your feedback on Steam or Discord.
Discord: https://discord.gg/MzSeaZH448
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9bb93eaf43cd0dc42af86711799fae171dc3e3c2.gif[/img]
[h3]We hope you all will have a lot of fun while playing our game![/h3]

As you all might know we originally planned to release at the end of October, but preparations for the release took a bit longer than expected. That's why we had to make the hard decision to move the release into early November. We want to apologize for that. 

We are working hard on adding new features and improvements, to make the release as good as it can possible be.
We hope you all look forward to the release of the Early Access!
Join us on this incredible journey. We are inviting all of you to visit a mysterious island.
[previewyoutube=PGFe1vQ6jO8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]A Survival  Game with Adventure & RPG elements.[/h2]

You are a pirate, who got stranded on the mysterious island called "Luminora" and you go on a journey through its breathtaking landscapes. A little fairy will help you exploring this magical place.
Build up your home, craft tools and weapons, and hunt wild animals for food at daytime, but be careful... at night masses of enemies will try to get you. So you need to prepare yourself for combat and build up your defense while crafting different traps to keep these wild attackers away from you. Since you are a pirate, you will be even be able to build your own little ship!
There are many different areas to explore, secrets to discover and mysteries to solve.

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
We want to thank our community for supporting us from the beginning and believing in our vision!
The feedback we receive motivates us every day to improve IfSunSets even more. 
Our mission is to make a game you all can enjoy and we will implement your suggestions and ideas during the early access.
Your feedback is crucial to shape the future experience for the game!
So suggestions, ideas, reports about issues etc, are always welcome.

You can write us your feedback on Steam or Discord.

notes.title: Traps, Traps, Traps!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
today we want to update our players about the new traps we are implementing, so that you have different ways to defend yourself against the enemies coming at night. 

IfSunSets has different types of traps to offer.

[h2]A Big Variety Of Traps[/h2]
We added new types of traps to the game, so that you have more variety to defend your base against the horde of enemies!

[h3]Cthuga Power[/h3]
The Cthuga Power Unit is made out of Cthuga stones and it operates only at night.
The power range is determined by the grade, and when it operates at night, it activates automatic traps and turret traps within the power range. 
Although it is classified as a trap, it is conceptually a device that infuses power rather than a traditional trap.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/11cd9ac9e77aa2d041ce0a98c6a2a8ff4478d128.gif[/img]

[h3]Automatic Traps[/h3]
These traps can be installed with a construction module.
You need Cthu to power these traps and they only operate at night.
You can build rotating blades, traps which push enemies away and much more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/d7738ceffc9af81bdcd1631e6bdc7b500fb108a7.gif[/img]

[h3]Turrets[/h3]
You will be also able to put Turret traps on the ground or an foundation.
Only if it is within the area of Cthuga Power a turret can work. If enemies enter the field of view, the turret starts to attack!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/b3d299d53ac30f42dd188d355d46b59fbd37deb7.gif[/img]

Of course you have more types of traps at your disposal.

[h3]Stationary Traps[/h3]
You can put these on the floor and once built they do their job and you just have to wait for enemies to run against your traps. If you choose a meat trap for example the enemies will run towards the meat instead of running in the direction of the player. Spikes will damage the enemies who touch them 
(But be carefull, they might damage you as well)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/eacb89493cda0009589b240dfefcf0caee7f52b1.gif[/img]
[h3]Floor Traps[/h3]
These traps can be integrated on the foundation. Place them on the floor and your enemies will get damage while running over them. This way you can also slow down enemies as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/b36e8010770feda41d0cc61ac552c57357e94035.gif[/img]
[h3]Defense Walls[/h3]
These Defense Walls can be put on the ground and help preventing enemies from entering your place. You can find here also doors and walls with spikes as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/d8a440e02998fa83353aa616741f4f3c5be07501.gif[/img]
[h3]Mines[/h3]
Mines can be put on the ground or foundations. If an enemy walks against it, or the mine receives damage, it will explode and it will cause great damage to everyone around the mine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/1d603e17e3f1ab5c2119052c894494adb01fe79f.gif[/img]

That is all for today!
We know you all are waiting for the early access and we can assure all of you that we will announce the release date of the early access soon.

Your feedback is always welcome. You can write your feedback on Steam or Discord.
Discord: https://discord.gg/MzSeaZH448
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9bb93eaf43cd0dc42af86711799fae171dc3e3c2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Game Modes Are Coming
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Right now, we are hard at work and preparing the early access release of IfSunSets later this month. 
([u]The release date will be revealed very soon[/u])

The feedback during the beta test was overwhelming and while many of you loved the gameplay loop of survival at daytime and defending against a horde of enemies at night, some others wanted an option to focus on the survival or exploration during their time on the Island of Luminora.
So we went back to the drawing board and added different modes you can choose from at the beginning of the game. 
So each player will have the opportunity to tweak IfSunSets to their liking. 

[h2]Play the way you want![/h2]
At the start of the game you will have the choice between three modes.
[b]SAFE NIGHT MODE, STANDARD MODE and CUSTOM MODE.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ae92fc454f9c9306aa5e961b6165fde478753423.png[/img][i]*Translation not final[/i][h3]SAFE NIGHT MODE:[/h3]
Many people love the waves of Monsters coming at night, but some users just want to enjoy the game without being terrified about a horde of enemies coming to get you at night. It still has 
This mode is for them! The SAFE NIGHT MODE won't have monster waves coming at night.
Except that, it is similar to STANDARD MODE. It still has dungeons to explore and you can find other enemies on the island.
[h3]STANDARD MODE:[/h3]
This is the mode which includes the enemy waves at night and you can see it as "normal difficulty" for the game.
[h3]CUSTOM MODE:[/h3]
Every player is different and this mode is for everyone who wants to customize different aspects of the game to their liking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/762a8f1cee774d1c88eacf6901d3e4856b86973e.png[/img][i]*Translation not final[/i]

[b]In CUSTOM MODE you can change many aspects of IfSunSets to your liking.[/b]
[list]
[*] Change how quickly hunger or thirst sets in. 
[*] Adjust the number of enemies that appear at night.
[*] Customize the length of day and night cycles
[/list][b]Create your own hardcore or easy mode.[/b][list]
[*] Tweak enemy damage.
[*] Modify the amount of EXP you receive.
[*] Increase or decrease Trap Damage.
[/list][b]You can even change the penalty for dying in CUSTOM MODE.[/b]
[list]
[*] Are you getting frustrated by games which give you penalties for dying? 
Choose the Penalty Option: [i]None[/i].
[*] Do you enjoy some pain and want to loose your Items you have with you when dying? 
Choose [i]Item Drop[/i].
[*] Or maybe you welcome the fear of loosing everything and want to experience the harshest consequences when dying in the game. 
In that case choose the Penalty Option: [i]Everything[/i]
[/list][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
We are also working on fixing different bugs which the community informed us about during open beta.
[list]
[*] We fixed some crashing issues during the Character Creation.
[*] The "Ultra Black Shadow Bug" is fixed and should not appear anymore at release of early access.
[*] We are fixing multiple Multiplayer issues the community told us about during the beta. 
[/list]We are confident, that the multiplayer experience will be way better on Early Access than it was during the Beta but we are only a small team and we are sure you all might find more issues and bugs during your gameplay, when the game releases into early access.
During Early Access we will do regular updates and add more and more features over time.

[h3]Features coming soon after early access release[/h3]
One feature we want to implement in one of the first updates after the release of the early access version of the game is Controller Support. Sadly we won't be able to implement Controller Support at release but we are actively working on it and will add it as soon as we can.

We take user feedback very seriously and the SAFE NIGHT and CUSTOM modes are direct results of the involvement of our community. Thank you all for your support! 
The early access release is around the corner ;)

If you have further feedback, let us know via Steam or Discord.
Discord: https://discord.gg/MzSeaZH448
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9bb93eaf43cd0dc42af86711799fae171dc3e3c2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Beta Test Feedback!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We want to thank all of you for participating in our Beta playtest.
[h2]The Beta Test was a full success.[/h2]
The feedback from all of you was overwhelming and it helped us a lot to see what works well, and what features still need some improvements before we release into early access. 

Below we list up some of the Issues you found and told us to focus on improving upon early access release. So after we did read through all your comments on Steam, Social Media and via our survey, we are decided to focus on fixing and improving the following before the release of early access, which is planned for October.

[h2]Most Wanted Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Fatal Error Fixes:[/b] issue during character customization and when changing the graphics setting. Additionally a bug was will be fixed which appears when entering day 2.
[i]Although we cannot promise, that all issues will be completely fixed on release, it has the highest priority and we are working hard on fixing them.[/i]
[*] [b]Multiplayer Bug Fixes:[/b] We heard you loud and clear and we are focusing on fixing all bugs, which were mentioned on Steam and Discord. We will continue to closely monitor multiplayer bugs during the early access period as well.
[*] [b]Ultra Black Shadow Bug Fix:[/b] We have resolved the bug where shadows appear completely black when adjusting graphic settings and this issue should not appear in on release.
[/list]
[h2]Most Wanted Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Night Defense Improvements:[/b] Revamp of the Night Defense system with three key changes.
[/list][olist]
[*]    Introducing a level scaling system for wave monsters.
[*]    Clearly distinguishing the enemies during the enemy waves 
    [i](normal enemies, jumpers, tank, exploding enemies, range attack dealing enemies etc.)[/i]
[*] Various trap systems and balancing adjustments.
[/olist][list]
[*] [b]Tutorial improvement: [/b]We will add a Game Guide and the Tutorial can be turned off. 
[*] [b]Blipfia Dialogue improvement:[/b] Blipfias dialogue will be simplified and interacting with her should be more userfriendly.
[*] [b]Skill System Improvements: [/b]The skill-system will undergo a complete overhaul, and merchants will sell skill reset potions. 
[*] [b]Fishing improvements:[/b] Improved fishing icon and making the fishing system easier to understand. Also an Fishing EXP issue will be fixed.
[*] [b]World Mode Settings (First release):[/b] A mode for players who dislike combat and don’t like the combat at night, the will be options to choose different modes. World Mode settings will continue to evolve in future updates.
[*] [b]New Weapon Skills:[/b] Some special weapons will have unique skills activated by holding down the attack button.
[/list]
[h2]Quality-of-Life improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The last built item will be remembered when exiting building mode.
[*] Favorite system for upgrade materials.
[*] Nails can be crafted using iron -> bronze as materials.
[*] UI/UX Convenience Improvements
[/list]

We will also fix further issues and are also working on improving the translation over time.
Please be aware, that as a small Indie Developer we are not able to implement everything you asked for upon release, but we are hard at work to implement these over time.

Once more, we want to say thank you!
We are aware that there is more to improve in the future and we also work hard on improving the game in the future. 

Some features we plan to add after the start of the access are controller support, implementing a Lock-On system, sneak system with assassination mechanics, a weather system, Pairing System for Multiplayer, new enemies and so much more. 

We hope you look forward to the upcoming release. We are excited!

notes.title: Prologue Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

From now on IfSunSets will have a brand-new Demo available, called "IfSunSets Prologue", which will succeed the former Demo which had an internal in-game time-limit of 6 days. 
IfSunSets won’t have this 6-day time-limit anymore and the explorable area of the Island is limited compared to the full release of the main game.

Gather resources during the day and fend off attacking enemies at night! 
Enemies that appear at night become stronger as the days progress.
A multitude of traps and craftable items are available. Prepare for the waves of enemies with a variety of traps and other crafted items!
[i]*The prologue does not offer multiplayer.[/i]

[h1]Major Changes:[/h1]
[h2]No In-Game Time-Limit![/h2]
The old Demo had an in-game time-limit and you were only able to play until day 6.
The Prologue Demo has no time-limit restriction anymore!
[i]* Please note that the explorable area is limited compared to the main game.[/i] 
To explore the whole Island of Luminora stay tuned for the upcoming Early Access release!

[h2]Translation Improvements:[/h2]
English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional) translations have been greatly improved!
That includes improvements to the translation of the main menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ba2f8ed7f16336b78955fb84551996798f4d7893.png[/img]
*There may still be some areas that need improvement. 
Please report any issues on our Discord channel, and we will address them quickly!

[h2]Tutorial overhaul:[/h2]
The tutorial has been completely revamped to provide a more natural flow and detailed system explanations and has been updated so that previously completed actions needed for a tutorial-quest will now be considered in future tutorial-quests 
(e.g., if a building is constructed before receiving the quest, that part of the tutorial will automatically be seen as completed).

[h2]Further Improvements:[/h2]
Visual indicators for construction durability have been added: 
changes in appearance at 100% -> 50% -> 10% durability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/8d82b2385beb644d7cc7637b5afdbb1edfdf5f11.png[/img]
Our fairy Blipfia should now appear even prettier in the fairy menu.

The Fairy-Energy tab is no longer in use. Fairies will now continuously restore their own energy. Press F1 for faster recovery. The initial energy value of Blipfia has been changed from 100 to 200.

Key Bindings: Icons and descriptions change now appropriately when key bindings are changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/4e9d31b2bb24eba9653c4c4962af65a79135be0b.png[/img]
All uses of the Cthugha's Stones have been unified under 'Cthugha's Stone.' Cthugha's Stone Fragments are now only used to craft Cthugha's Stones.)

No consumable items are needed for teleportation between altars! Just click on the altar icon you want to teleport to that altar!

New sound effects have been added (footsteps, step effects, and weapon-specific sounds).

14 new types of traps added.

Item quantities and consumption rates have been tripled.

Received Gold has been increased significantly.

The respawn time for all enemies and animals has been significantly reduced.

The respawn time for bundle items (items that can be harvested multiple times) has been greatly reduced.

The acquisition rates for fibers and branches are increased.

Map Changes:
Improved the accessibility and added items around the 'Jungle Mountain' area.

All fish sale prices have been increased.

Added new early-game items: solid club and solid spear.

Added a bag as item for gliders.

Added 2 new recipes.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Addressed some bugs related to graphic settings. 
(e.g., incorrect or failed setting values.)

Fixed an issue with flickering at specific times when using the Ultra option for Lighting.

Fixed key binding bugs (e.g., keys not registering or only previous key settings functioning).

Partially fixed the 'Fatal Error' bug occurring during customization.
Note: not fully resolved yet; a complete fix is planned for a future build.

Resolved bugs related to the creation of your ship.
(e.g., inability to board ships, incorrect model display when ships are destroyed)

Fixed various cooking pot bugs 
(e.g., inability to cook, interaction issues when moving during cooking.)

Fixed a bug where quests were not functioning properly.

Resolved an issue where wildlife respawn was not working correctly.

Fixed a bug where some materials inside the storage were not being usable for crafting.

Addressed an issue of some items being obtained as duplicates.

Fixed a problem where dungeon progress was not being saved
 (e.g., dungeon levers, doors, traps).

Made extensive adjustments to floating meshes.

Fixed the issue with the 'Hell Boar' blocking access to certain wooden areas and fixed the problem of the 'Hell Boar' returning to its spot too quickly.

Resolved an issue where upgrade materials were not appearing at the Level 4 armor workstation.

Fixed an issue where certain vegetables could not be cooked.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[b]Black Shadow Bug:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9f0ba51a469b96c3608f20a330930245797917f7.png[/img]
There is an issue where the shadows turn completely black when loading a game after saving. 
To resolve this, please go to [b]Settings -> Graphics Settings -> and set the Effect Quality to 'Epic'[/b]. 
Once resolved, you can change the options as you wish without encountering the problem again. 
We are working hard to resolve this issue but currently cannot identify the cause. 
We will make sure to address this issue in the next update.

[h3]These are the changes for our new demo, IfSunSets Prologue![/h3]

If you find any issues, please report them on our Discord channel (link down below), or write a review on our prologue steam page. We will address them as soon as possible!
Discord: https://discord.gg/MzSeaZH448
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9bb93eaf43cd0dc42af86711799fae171dc3e3c2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Beta Test Coming September 4th!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

This is the IfSunSets development team.

Today we have exciting news to share with all of you!

We will start our Beta Test [b]September 4th[/b] and you all will be able to try it out [b]until September 11th[/b].

We encourage everyone to participate in the Beta and provide us with valuable feedback, which will help us deliver an outstanding product for our Early Access launch in October.

Stay tuned for an upcoming announcement with detailed information about the changes and new features.

You can give us your feedback here on steam or join us on Discord.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update Now Live!!!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 
This is the IfSunSets development team. 
We are thrilled to bring you another update announcement. 
We are still working hard on fixing bugs and developing new content. 
We promise to continue doing our best in the development, and we are excited to share the details of this update and hotfix with you. 


[h2]Major Changes: 
The Multiplayer (Beta) is now available!!![/h2]
Exploring the Luminora Island on your own might make you feel a bit lonely from time to time.
Now you can team up with fellow pirates! Arr!
[b]You will be able to test the Beta of our multiplayer[/b] [strike]until August 18th 2024!
So we hope you all play the Multiplayer (Beta) with other pirates during this time![/strike]
[i]Edit: You will be able to play the multiplayer part of our Demo for an expanded period of time![/i]
*Please note that multiplayer is still lacking many features and is only in beta for now. 
There are known bugs as well as many bugs which we haven’t discovered yet. 
To be honest, it’s more like a “take a look at multiplayer” situation right now.
If you encounter any errors, bugs, or other unpleasant experiences while playing, please report them via the Steam community page or through our discord-server.
[b]On discord we have a survey prepared for you as well. [/b]
So please let us know what you think about our multiplayer 
We value all your feedback and will address them promptly! Thank you!

[b]Please check the following important notes:[/b]
The Multiplayer operates on a P2P basis. Since it places a significant load on the host PC, please only attempt it on a PC that meet or exceed the recommended specifications. 
For cross-platform play between players on Steam and STOVE, we use "EOS (Epic Games Online Services)".
For a small developer like us, this is a way, to make online play between users across different platforms possible.
An Epic Games account will be required to use multiplayer.

You can play the Multiplayer (Beta) using the following method:
Step 1: Select Multiplayer (Beta) in the main menu.
Step 2: Sign in with your Epic Games Account.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c9867968957c7964de57d0f2f38497c354e840a2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/988ff1803184760643d24d6bda77168e8ac17ae0.jpg[/img]
Done!
After that you will be able to create a server or join a Server created by a friend. 

[h3]Changed Keyboard Keys:[/h3]
We have changed the default key bindings that many of you found inconvenient. 
We sincerely appreciate your patience in playing the game despite these issues.
(Attention!) If you had custom key settings before, you might still be using the old key bindings rather than the new ones. 
While not mandatory, we recommend pressing the 'Reset' button in the key settings to enjoy the game with updated key bindings. 
(As a system to update key guides according to custom key settings is still in development, using custom keys may cause confusion.)
With the change in default keys, many bugs are expected, such as issues with key bindings (in options) not being properly applied. We will prioritize fixing these bugs and aim to release a hotfix next week.
Changes:
1.	Inventory key changed from [ I ] to [ TAB ].
2.	Interaction key changed from [ E ] to [ F ].
3.	Due to changes in keys 1 and 2, Blifia’s skill keys are now [ E = Change Skill, Q = Use Skill ].
4.	Added right-click to quickly open the item menu within the inventory.
5.	Functions previously activated by right-clicking the mouse have been changed to double-click.
In Progress:
1.	A system to reflect key changes in the key guide UI.
2.	Persistent key guide UI.

[h3]Content Improvements:[/h3]
- Font Change: The game font has been updated. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/80ccd94aa1e645ba4bf85f70f13fb7818d9af98d.png[/img]
We are still searching for a font that suits the game best.

- Tutorial Improvement: 
The tutorial has been improved and is now better organized with clearer objectives.
We are also working on a feature to check and complete objectives before they appear in the Tutorial-Quest. Please stay tuned!

- Fairy Tab 
UI polishing improvements have been made to reduce the inconvenience of switching between windows. The category order in the Fairy Tab has been reorganized based on importance.

- Increased stages for spike traps and defensive walls
Upgrades are now possible from wood -> stone -> iron.

- Ship Hammer Update 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/251ded45b6b4f77b3c8342737ae0af77d0005848.png[/img]
You can now craft and sail your own boat! We look forward to your magnificent voyages! Underwater monsters, underwater items, and events are not yet available but will be integrated in future updates. We hope you look forward to it! 
PS. Ship hammers can be obtained from someone related to boats!

[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
The Spring Whale (explosive whale wave monster) will no longer stop exploding when attacked. 
It must be defeated to stop the explosion. The damage of the Spring Whale explosion has been significantly reduced.

Trap damage in castle dungeons has been reduced by 50%. We apologize for the overly strong damage that affected gameplay enjoyment.

The number of wild boars encountered at the start has been reduced and they have been made weaker. New players should find it easier to handle them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fdc7a7c66aacb6c97fe6fc53a83f38aabf6fa21e.jpg[/img]

The acquisition rate of the oxygen-replenishing item ‘Gill Pool’ has been significantly reduced.

Monsters near the teleportation destination altar have been removed to prevent deaths during loading. You can now teleport with the mind of peace!

Soldier stats have been adjusted.

[h3]Design Improvements:[/h3]
The design and detail work of the jungle entrance has been updated.
Details on the cliff tops have been enhanced in preparation for the glider.
There are various design improvements made in different areas of the game.

[Hotfixes]
[list]
- Fixed a bug where rewards were not received after clearing the Squirmy.
- Fixed an issue where players were moved to the castle after falling through the floor.
- Fixed an issue where players were moved to the castle after falling through the floor.
- Removed the save function from the bed (you can now save anywhere!)
- Fixed a save/load bug related to building ownership.
- Corrected terrain issues where players were blocked by invisible walls.
- Resolved an issue where palm trees could not be planted.
- Fixed a bug where the repair kit’s repair value would suddenly drop to 0%.
- Fixed a bug where the farmer NPC Aiden was not present at Erwen’s defense base.
- Fixed a bug where obtaining the Purification Ring blueprint unlocked the crocodile equipment. (If the same bug occurs, please try to reload the save and report if it happens again!)
- Fixed a bug where wave monsters occasionally stepped on players' heads.
- Fixed a bug where wave monsters sometimes stood still. (It is normal that they do not swim in the sea. We are working on making wave monsters swim underwater.)
- Changed the map display from “Cthugha Stones” to “Cthugha Stone Fragment.”
- Fixed an issue where standing on certain desert terrain caused players to float in mid-air.
- Fixed world holes that occasionally appeared.
- Fixed floating items found in various places.
- Ensured that the location for rescuing Laura is no longer destructible.
- Fixed a bug where some items in Blifia’s bag skill would disappear from the inventory.
[/list]
You are always welcome to give feedback or report bugs on our discord channel.
Follow us on social media channels!
X (Twitter): https://x.com/IFSUNSETSgame

Discord: https://discord.gg/MzSeaZH448

notes.title: To all who await IfSunsets - Prepare to set sail!
notes.content:
Hello, this is POLYMORPH Studios, the developer of IfSunsets.

As we approach the final stages before our Early Access release, we wanted to take this opportunity to express our gratitude to all of you who have supported and patiently awaited IfSunsets.

POLYMORPH has a unique history. We began as a team creating CG for blockbuster movies. 
Through our work and our shared love for games, we transitioned from discussing our favorite games to dream of creating a game that encompassed everything we imagined.

Thus, driven by our passion for gaming, we embarked on a new challenge. 
IfSunsets marks the beginning of this journey and our debut title.

We understand that developing a sandbox game as our team's first project presents significant challenges. 
However, as gamers and developers who love this genre, we were determined not to give up on our dream simply because it was difficult. 
It's about wanting to create a world where many can share, experience, and fulfill their aspirations.

There have been many milestones along the way. Game development has not been easy. 
As developing for the first time, we faced numerous trials and errors. 
Your feedback left in the community each time was invaluable. 
The warm encouragement and constructive criticisms you gave when we first revealed our demo remain unforgettable. 
They made us realize our shortcomings, understand what we were missing, and get excited about new ideas.

Our development team, which started with just two people aiming to fully integrate everyone's opinions and our thoughts into the game, has grown to ten members. Together, we are moving forward each day toward our goals.

Participating in Steam Next Fest allowed us to meet more people and hear more stories. 
Moreover, collaborating with Smilegate, a partner who empathizes with our passion, has enabled us to present a better game to all of you. 
IfSunsets has surpassed 100,000 wishlists and is now setting sail beyond that milestone, with the day of our voyage beginning to come into view.

We believe IfSunsets wouldn't have come this far without all of you.
Many say a game is not a mere "product" but a "work of art." We aspire to earn your recognition not through hasty outputs, but by crafting a "work of art" that resonates with all of you.

To all the users who have been with us for a long time, we sincerely thank you. 
We will continue to grow through communication with the community in the future.


The Early Access release is just around the corner. 
We are focused on enhancing the game's completeness. 
Since Steam Next Fest, we have made significant improvements and added various content. 

We plan to conduct pre-playtests as the final preparation stage before release. 
We will provide detailed information regarding the playtest schedule in mid-August.
Our hope is that everyone playing IfSunsets can freely adventure within this world and create their own stories. 

We look forward to meeting you soon on the island of Luminora, brimming with adventures and secrets.

Thank you sincerely, 
POLYMORPH Studios 


For more information, please follow us on our social media channels and wishlist us on Steam.

- Twitter: https://x.com/IFSUNSETSgame

- Discord: https://discord.gg/MzSeaZH448



P.S.
By the way, late at night when no one's around, a little fairy sneaks in to lend a hand. 
Surprisingly helpful at times!

notes.title: [★Update Note 2024.07.19★]
notes.content:
[h1][b][★Update Note 2024.07.19★] 
[/b][/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/80a29b28b2cbdeec281f8f4fc6b8d91eab2a7122.jpg[/img]


Hello! This is the IfSunSets development team.
It has already been a month since our last update.
Since then, we have strapped on boosters and charged forward once again!
Check out what updates we have made and enjoy the fun gameplay.
Our game still has many issues, but we will never give up and continue to work hard to make it truly enjoyable!
We sincerely thank everyone who supports us and those who continue to enjoy our game.
We will keep pushing forward with more energy!

Thank you!


[h3]Notice
[/h3]There are some areas where the terrain has changed with this update.
After loading a saved file, you may find that your house is buried in rocks.
We were unable to consider this issue in this update.
Next time, we will make sure to take this into account when updating the terrain.
Also, if you set the visibility range too low while playing in a dungeon,
you might experience the walls or floors disappearing.
We have not yet completed the work to separate the walls and floors from the visibility settings.
Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h1][Content][/h1]


[h2]Dungeon
[/h2]

A new desert dungeon has been created, featuring new rewards and new monsters!

[h3]Desert Dungeon
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/274304b9de7b9a89b7ba821cde014a19d1c7eec3.png[/img]
The cutscene for the final boss of the desert dungeon is still in production.
It will be included in a future update.


[h2]Castle Dungeon
[/h2]
A new castle dungeon has been created, featuring new rewards and new monsters!
Look forward to dungeon play filled with various traps and engaging stories.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/0a56e4a08b72ff03c9ea66517088b3767f38a0da.png[/img]


[h2]Ocean[/h2]
The Ocean Has Completely Changed!
We are actively working on our next update, the 'Marine Content'.
As part of this effort, we have prioritized updating the ocean, which will be the main stage for various marine content.
Check out the new items available for the marine content!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/dc01fe9b6cb56f592f2dc2a5ad7dc2a3438af4cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/bbe46cbd3fa5c06b3bb24fdf9bcffbd14b8a431b.gif[/img]


[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
A tutorial quest has been created for new players starting the quest game.
Currently, only the tutorial quest is available, but
the next update will include a variety of other quests as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c4a459145dbfcc7c21acc6c3668dc0aaec42bcba.png[/img]


[h2]Interaction[/h2]
The system interaction method has completely changed!
If there are things to interact with nearby,
you can interact with the closest one to you.
When there are multiple objects, priority is given to the one closest to the crosshair.
Enjoy the game with this more convenient interaction system!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/7729a5537eccfe70e477d36bf34adbf59e4a4b67.png[/img]


[h2]Boss Monster Renewal[/h2]
Our three major bosses, Brownbeard, Apophates, and Ironheart, have been completely revamped!
Play against the newly reborn bosses with new patterns and concepts!
I've managed to clear Brownbeard and Apophates, but I haven't beaten Ironheart yet...
[previewyoutube=kbfY3rxPkk4;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=tqwAe-cTm50;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=skwh7bRmoVY;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Food and Buffs[/h2]
Food has been revamped, and various buffs have been added!
When you build a house, you can obtain various buffs by cooking and eating 'comfort' food available inside your home.
Additionally, health no longer recovers immediately unless you use a health potion.
However, if you eat until you're full and activate the 'satiety' buff, your health will gradually recover!
Foods that used to only satisfy hunger now come with their own unique buff effects.
Find the foods with the buffs that suit you best, and use various buffs to survive!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/048734a47635cf5e4f3469101481b7e12b44f35b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c1c459d0d2945522319e8536807c24d6359385d4.png[/img]


[h2]UI[/h2]
The UI has been revamped!
The UI will continue to improve in terms of convenience and design both now and in the future.
Look forward to a more stylish and user-friendly UI!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/e8e07ee8a53afac0efe9186e3ab4f990f3b09a10.png[/img]


[h2]Feature: Arrow System[/h2]
Special arrows with unique abilities have been added to IfSunSets, which previously only had regular arrows!
Explosive arrows that deal damage to the surrounding area.
Electric arrows that slow down the movement speed of monsters.
Poison arrows that inflict continuous damage, among others.
Check out these various interesting arrows!
※ Bolts for crossbows will also be updated in the future!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ec4e81e45dba05f028e8487c8108020cb5a5bec1.png[/img]


[h2]New NPC[/h2]
A new NPC named 'Aiden' has arrived, sporting a cute bird on his head and a kind smile!
Aiden sells various farming-related items and cooking items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/3c157bf0dc4c808996565c5d21bc1a7c419fe90a.png[/img]



[h2]AI Overhaul[/h2]
Though still under detailed development, we have overhauled the AI that previously couldn’t detect arrows landing next to them.
The AI now has vision and hearing capabilities.
Activate crouch (C key) and approach monsters in a low stance!
If monsters aren’t directly looking at you, they won’t detect your presence.
However, if you’re not crouching or make loud noises, they will hear you and turn around, so be cautious!


[h2]Notes[/h2]
What secrets does this island hold?
Why did Ironheart come to this island?
What are the monsters that come at night?
Story notes that reveal various tales have been added!
Discover interesting stories scattered all around the island!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ac1d6fa55a27a230ae1584a7e3654ec775283033.png[/img]


[h2]Glider[/h2]
The glider has been added!
While it's not a full-fledged airplane, you can soar high and enjoy the breathtaking views of the islands from above!
The blueprint for crafting the glider can be found somewhere on the island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c205f35868a8866573bf1fcf25553d3cd95a0bab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/8afa724e9836bffbf8e84267f56817a8473084cf.png[/img]


[h2]Mounts[/h2]
Mounts have been added!
They are sold by Lora and can be obtained after paying a hefty price.
Higher-tier mounts require even more gold and specific conditions to be met, so keep that in mind!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c28f66e7a2d06bc6e5fd8e9083bfe6260c1fd554.png[/img]


[h2]Save System[/h2]
You can now save your game anytime, anywhere.
In a future update, we plan to support real-time saving for multiplayer (saving your current state when you exit the game).
The save function on beds has not been removed yet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/a14c200edfa186a792a4742d91d712d45cf42f8c.png[/img]



[h2]Shared Chest[/h2]
The 'Shared Chest' system has been added to IfSunSets!
Only one shared chest can be placed in the world, and the materials inside the shared chest can be accessed by all workbenches!
Now gather materials and put them in the shared chest!
However, the shared chest is hidden somewhere on the island!
You'll have to find the shared chest first, right?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9d7afabc85c3c1dc48a84b101ded4bd61cb4c146.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/0e86d227c78b1fd3ad65a060b30659891e7e17c1.png[/img]



[h2]Workbench Retrieval Function[/h2]
Now, workbenches can be retrieved!
Previously, many people found it difficult to move their homes because workbenches couldn't be retrieved.
With the retrieval function of the hammer, you can now retrieve all workbenches!
However, please remember that the contents inside the workbench will immediately pop out upon retrieval!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/b521f286c708cb48a3eb9d5e1327a2c3906e303d.png[/img]


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



[h1][Bug Fixes and Adjustments in Progress][/h1]

As new content has been created, many small bugs have been found in each content area.

We have fixed the visible bugs, but various other bugs may still occur in different situations.

We will address and fix all reported issues as quickly as possible.

However, considering the large file size of each update, we will resolve as many bugs as possible before proceeding with the updates!

In addition, the balance of the game is not yet perfectly refined due to the various new contents.

For example, some skills currently have a too wide range, and we plan to adjust this.

We are working on fine-tuning the balance,

and in the next update, we aim to deliver a more balanced gameplay experience.

Thank you.




---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h1][Content in Progress][/h1]

※ These are not yet included in the update list but will be part of the next update.



[h2]Shipbuilding System[/h2]
The 'Ship Mallet' has been introduced, allowing you to craft various ships!
Use the ship mallet to build different types of boats!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fecdc59a00cb56e77468b50451f21c6dbfdaa90f.png[/img]



[h2]Underwater AI Monsters[/h2]
The water is no longer safe...!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/66ec24722b0ec0830dba82b6d0f4ce2a0433bad1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/12f1c55ec68d78df0701fac52a47fb64889806cd.png[/img]



[h2]Stealth System[/h2]
A stealth system that activates when crouching has been designed.
It will be an essential feature for assassinations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/a97f29f14a136b0524e4ba1d5509d08bf98b4571.png[/img]



[h2]Multiplay[/h2]
Multiplay is coming soon!!!
We are working hard to add this feature as quickly as possible!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ea04274c16a6a11189c3ccb77cd9a5c8027bd3e5.png[/img]




---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------





Thank You!

notes.title: [2024.05.25 UPDATE NOTE] Important News!
notes.content:
[h1][20240525 UPDATE NOTE]
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/20f7d3c19c7aaa1e4a8badefef740b5ad74ccbaf.png[/img]

[h2]Important News!
[/h2]1. With this update, you can now play the demo up to DAY6!
2. We are participating in the Steam Open World Survival Crafting Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/d65f5cc4da44bd3aa4cbd8d5bfe74712feb5400b.png[/img]


[Content Update]


[h3]- The desert region has been added.
[/h3]Boss monsters and new dungeons will be added in future updates.


[h3]- New monsters have been added.
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/58e3c362e95baf49b8a667aac590db13a142e6d4.png[/img]
1) Rokle: Rolls up and attacks enemies by rolling.
2) Jellyfish: Paralyzes opponents with electric attacks.
3) Ocean Rock: Explodes upon death, dealing damage within a certain radius.
4) Shark Pirate Gang: Attacks with guns, bombs, hammers, and rapiers.
5) Fanaticism: Attack with various magic and swords.
6) Aggressive animals: Scorpions, Komodo dragons.
7) Non-aggressive animals: Desert foxes, meerkats, gazelles.


[h3]- New Equipment Added
[/h3]New earring/ring items have been added.
Armor to protect against high temperatures has been added.
Fire attribute weapons have been added.
1) Desert Ring/Earrings
2) Flame Ring/Earrings
3) Flame Sword/Greatsword/Hammer/Crossbow/Bow
4) Linen Armor Set
5) Desert Armor Set


[h3]- A baobab tree resting place that can avoid the effects of temperature has been added.
[/h3]

[h3]- Night defense has been revamped.
[/h3]Night is now considered a single stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fe9150f38ba7118f6ba3854d8ba7b6ff877a53ac.png[/img]

1) Waves start at 19:00.
2) The remaining time of the night, the number of monsters defeated, 
and survival status are displayed in the upper left corner.
3) If you fail a wave and die, you can choose to go back to the previous day, retry, or move to the next day.
4) If you succeed in a wave, you will receive accumulated experience, items, and Cthuga's Stones.


[h3]- A tree planting system has been developed.
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/618360293296c6a8f701b266a5c245819bb6c0cf.png[/img]
You can now plant trees wherever you want using their seeds.


[h3]- The animals' AI has been improved. Animals will now flee after actually seeing you.
[/h3]

[h3]- The swimming mechanics have been completely changed.
[/h3]Swimming now operates in dive mode and surface mode, and you can dive by pressing the C key.
In dive mode, you won't automatically surface; you can surface when you want.
You won't dive underwater unless you press the C key.
You can now perform melee attacks while swimming underwater (a system for underwater monsters will be added later).



[h3]- The fairy system has been completely overhauled.
[/h3]- The fairy UI has been completely revamped.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/70ae0e555e2c991ae40895d4e0727d2bedc9823d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6851b61bb16b32f27e0a068bb0c4ef1613c7b33a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9d2e26add6b02b82976296e3352e48ad3b753d67.gif[/img]

[Growth]
- You can level up the fairy with Cthuga's Stones and gain fairy points.

[Stats]
- You can increase the fairy's stats using fairy points.

[Skills]
- You can unlock skills for the fairy using fairy points.
Fairy skills include passive skills that are always active and active skills that can be used by pressing the Q key.
You can use skills with the Q key and switch skills with the TAP key.
Using skills consumes the fairy's energy.

[Energy]
- The fairy's energy recharges when entering rest mode by pressing the F1 key.
The fairy's energy can be recharged automatically or manually with Cthuga's Stones.

[Purification]
- You can now use fairy energy to restore purity from the purification tab.


[h3]- The appearance of the spike wall has been changed.
[/h3]It is now designed to allow visibility of the space behind it, enabling you to check the status of monsters.


[h3]- The ability to extinguish/ignite torches has been added.
[/h3]You can interact by pressing the E key.


[h3]- The desert area has been added, leading to a revamp with a new map.
[/h3]

[h3]- Construction has been revamped.
[/h3]Areas where alignment was slightly off have been corrected.
Issues with improper snapping have been fixed.
Problems with spacing in 2x2 fences have been addressed.
New roof modules have been added.





------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------





[Balance Changes]

- Animals now actively avoid players, making it slightly more difficult to catch them.

- Blocking has been improved for immediate response.

- Monsters can no longer pass through spike walls.

- The explosion range of Ocean Rocks has been adjusted to be more avoidable.

- Ocean Rocks are now slightly weaker.

- Two-handed swords' damage has been increased by 10%.

- Fixed an issue where 800 gold coins were coming out of unique chests.

- Laura will now sell dull iron swords again.

- Reduced the number of shells on the early beach.

- Fixed an issue where Flame Earrings/Rings were in Armor Workbench 1.

- Greenblue Spearman has been slightly weakened.

- Adjusted the position of Purification Gloves.





------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




[Bug Fixes]

notes.title: [UpdateNote 2024.04.05]
notes.content:
[h1][Content Update and Fix Notes 2024.04.05]
[/h1]

Hello, everyone!

This is the development team of If Sunset!

Hope you've all been well these past few weeks!

Today, we've brought updates on contents other than the desert update, along with bug fixes!

Thanks to many of you who have found various bugs and provided feedbacks on Discord and forums. We've been able to address many issues!

Currently, we are focusing on delivering the desert contents to you as soon as possible, while also concentrating on various optimizations!

We'll continue to do our best in game developing to update many other contents and achieve further optimization!

Thank you!!


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Contents Update
[/h1]


[h2]Content Related
[/h2]


[h3]Added the Crimson Marsh area!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/7943f0c9b347a628d5c674599ce6d98b67d4360b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fc3681bdc2e7ccfe291968739d4f5a2260726d80.png[/img]
The Crimson Marsh is an extremely dangerous area where contamination levels rise continuously. In this area, you can obtain new items newly added along with unique monsters and acquire blueprint items to craft special equipment that defends against contamination!


[h3]Introduced a new item called the Red Egg!
[/h3]
The Red Egg is an item that can be obtained in the Crimson Marsh. You can use Red Eggs to craft Red Potions. Red Potions not only restore health but also slightly reduce contamination.


[h3]Added a new monster called the OceanRock!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f1919c23e44cfb0c66ec564d6f723c769f4740ba.png[/img]
The OceanRock attacks like ordinary monsters but uses special abilities upon death.


[h3]Introduced Jellyfish monsters!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f48507a6f5c5f251521fd9044979a90277d86151.png[/img]
Jellyfish monsters use special abilities.


[h3]Inventory window UI has been changed!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/a05e7bfb02ebe13ebf7acb48ceb784665dea3d21.png[/img]
The UI will gradually change over time. Various elements like health bars, hotbars, etc., will be sequentially modified in the future.


[h3]Earrings and Rings equipments tab have been added!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/4d2f2387295321b5186f10266d2d61f12ee65b08.png[/img]
The new equipment tabs, Earrings and Rings, increase additional damage or attribute defense. Although there aren't many earring and ring items yet, more will be added gradually.


[h3]Element system has been added!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/4f757bf9fca04cc0ff7635b019dfdd1bf0e4e0b0.png[/img]
There are fire, water, nature, contamination, and purification element attributes. Water is strong against fire, fire is strong against nature, and nature is strong against water. Contamination and purification attributes deal additional damage to all attributes but oppose each other. When applying attribute damage to enemies, special abilities may be triggered probabilistically. Check out what special abilities are available!


[h3]Added Trap Mallet!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/b8efec5d087650499e5811ba7d0ec27be1567add.png[/img]
Unlike the conventional traps that had to be crafted and placed, Trap Mallet allows you to place traps similar to Construction Hammer if you have enough materials. You can freely pick up and move traps.


[h3]Various traps have been added!
[/h3]
Various traps that can kill monsters in new ways have been added.

Explosive Trap: Explodes significantly when damaged, dealing large area damage to enemies.
Mine Trap: Causes explosive area damage when monsters step on it.
Sticky Trap: When a monster steps on it, its movement speed significantly decreases.
Arrow Trap: Automatically hunts monsters using arrows when loaded with fuel.


[h3]Monster AI overhaul
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/e224b35a6b2a7619688ab0930f2abd3c647f67e4.gif[/img]

Wave Monsters

Wave monsters now attempt mantling. If they can't, they'll try to find a path to the player and destroy nearby structures if they can't reach the player. Wave monsters will now find the optimal path to reach the player. If the best path to the player is determined to be simply falling down, they will jump off cliffs to approach the player. There are no longer any places where wave monsters can't go!

Field Monsters

The concepts of ranged and melee have been implemented for field monsters. If a monster has a charge weapon while far away from itself, it will charge the player, and if it shoots arrows while the player is nearby, it will roll back or attempt to kick backward.

Furthermore, we're implementing AI that calculates more cases, is more complex, and moves smarter. In the future, If Sunset's monsters will become much smarter! Just like they're alive!

Implemented a feature to store duplicate items at once!
If there are duplicate items in your inventory or the boxes you've made, you can now store them all at once.


[h3]Item Slot System has been developed!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9a93e4e480dda819b7e9b6882f7b8bb0925c1ba1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9260e4b567e8f4210ce192661106c7c5b9913ee6.gif[/img]

What is the Item Slot?

It's a system that allows you to put decorations and modification items into equipment and weapons to give them additional abilities! You can obtain decorations and modification items through farming and crafting! Keep an eye out for blueprints scattered throughout the island, and enhance your equipment items more powerfully!


[h3]Monster optimization work has been done!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/572e97de0f74b72098a3a7d4adf1f8d35c7fd5b1.png[/img]

The amount of data for monsters has been greatly reduced. Gameplay should now be smoother! We'll continue to optimize to provide smoother gameplay!


[h3]Electrical device system has been added!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/01e7f0e0855af5cca873c4d68f2e7ae682b0eaf3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/39aec6e256b922990a280666fe4f865f09a14772.png[/img]
You can now place electrical device turrets through Trap Hammer, powered by fragments of Ktuga and purified Ktuga stones. Electrical devices are much stronger and sturdier than regular traps. To use electrical devices, you can craft Mana Regulators and Mana Generators through the workbench.


[h3]World map marker system has been added!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f202f781fbf8c6017a39db9c9c673b34b0103575.png[/img]
You can now mark on the world map and edit it as you like!

Pressing 'E' for auto-pickup now automatically closes the window!
Many of you found this feature inconvenient, so we've changed it to automatically close the window when you pick up all items.


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




[h2]Bug Fixes
[/h2]


Changed the mouse activation/deactivation key from Q to L.

Fixed the bug where pressing the Tap key to open the inventory also displayed the log.

Fixed the bug where climbing to high places and rolling would cause the map to break and fall down.

Fixed the bug where '?' would appear for uncooked dishes, now mouse-overing will reveal the information of the completed dish.

Fixed the blueprint experience infinite bug.

Fixed the bug where you couldn't upgrade equipment even when the anvil was upgraded to the maximum.

Fixed the bug where gold ore was not coming out.

Fixed the missing translation for the resurrection button after death.

Fixed the bug where item grades affected attack range.

Reduced the amount of stones flying when mining ore.

Added the added stats from enhancement to the tooltip.

Durability now varies by item grade.

Fixed parts where the text was too small to read. (Item tooltip, workbench description, etc.)

Fixed the bug where two puzzles were generated upon entering the boss room.

Fixed the bug where crops would stop growing even after watering and fertilizing.

Fixed the bug where the roofs of buildings collided strangely.

Reduced the duration of fuel due to balance issues.

Changed watering crops twice and significantly changed wet ground.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




[h1]Work in Progress
[/h1]
Increasing more monsters!
We're not just increasing the numbers, we're creating special mid-boss monsters that utilize special gimmicks.


Developing desert content!
The desert will feature various new items, NPCs, and monsters forming new groups!

Please look forward to the desert content to be revealed this month!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/95c44559e52e75446688d425d72aaa28881401c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/7094355493e7acd0d4180769f910c175527ed40b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/870a22a8cee9d8c5d7595715fb4e814a5ab27bf2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/4ad503cf59e3a6bdbba3fabc3b25bcffaafea159.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/34d924a5c9b24a81799867375def59c04a7a44aa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/3709dd27b704e85cd2ce65dc13287e3597856276.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/96fd0be68546bd14a59a518f15c8b9d8dce8dc5e.png[/img]


For more information about desert content, you can refer to the official YouTube channel 'Game Meeting' Episode 43, where you can find a lot of information and development process!
